- Serialized merge lanes now release a held front PR on the next queued or self-authored sweep and promote the next waiting PR, instead of waiting for the front timeout ([#14934](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14934)).
- Contributor-lane auto-merge now respects the serialized merge lane, rechecks contributor authorization for the pinned head, and leaves branch updates and merge effects to the lane ([#14935](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14935)). Owner-approved workflow changes retain human-action parking when the App lacks workflow permissions.
- Serialized merge lane: a definite GitHub refusal (403, 405, 422) of the front's merge call is now recorded as not applied, so the pull request leaves the front and the next waiter is promoted within one round instead of waiting out the front timeout; 5xx and transport errors stay uncertain ([#14936](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14936)).
- The dashboard 🔀 "Queue auto-merge when checks pass" button is now enabled for PRs whose checks are still running or that are behind the base branch, with tooltips saying what will happen; it stays disabled only for conflicting (`dirty`) and draft PRs.
- Refuse dashboard auto-merge queues whose recorded actor is not an owner or merger in `dashboard.authorized_users`, and explain merge-time authorization refusals with one PR comment per head.
- Headless contributor runs now report broken-environment verdicts as environment failures even when the CLI exits successfully, so unfinished issues can be reassigned instead of counted as completed.
- Activity Monitor: an issue the hive parked on a pull request (`<!-- hive:blocked-on pr=owner/repo#N -->`, the review backlog's spin-off issues) now names it — the payload carries `blocked_on_pr: {repo, number, url, state}` (state from the hive's caches, never a fresh GitHub call), the `blocked` pill reads `blocked on #N` and links the PR with a tooltip saying what lifts the block, and the caption reads `Blocked on PR #N` instead of `No stage recorded yet`. The hive's own `blocked` removal (blocked sweep, review-backlog block lift) now re-reads the issue live like an inbound label webhook, and a reconcile enumeration that started before such a re-read no longer overwrites it on publish — rows had stayed `blocked` for ~an hour after the hive itself lifted the label (#14952).
- Headless task failures now report the captured CLI output as evidence to the hub, so a failed headless task includes its final output (such as the verdict line) instead of an empty tail ([#14962](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14962)).
- fix(gfi): apply the configured label-approval policy to GFI provenance and log lookup failures (#14963)
- The dashboard no longer marks an issue as Reviewing just because an open pull request mentions it: a PR found by search or by a timeline cross-reference counts as the linked PR only when its title or body closes the issue (Closes/Fixes/Resolves); a PR that names the issue only in a PR comment is still linked ([#14966](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14966)).
- CI Go jobs (`v2-ci`, `v2-tests`, `go-security-analysis`, `testutil-guard`) now pre-fill the module cache through a shared `go-mod-download-retry` action that retries `go mod download` with exponential backoff, so a transient `proxy.golang.org` stream reset (`INTERNAL_ERROR`) no longer fails golangci-lint, govulncheck, gosec or the sharded tests; this completes the Docker builder-stage retry from #14990 ([#14976](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14976)).
- Docker image builds now retry `go mod download` up to 3 times with short backoff, so a transient Go module proxy stream reset (`INTERNAL_ERROR`) no longer fails the build job (#14976).
- The Hive activity monitor's **Needs human** chip now counts and filters only rows a person alone can advance — stages 015/045/085/090, 071/072 with a human author, or a `needs-human` / `needs-decision` / `unauthorized` pill — from one predicate shared by the chip count, the filter, and the new `needs_human` / `on_hold` payload totals; held rows get their own **On hold** chip, and `hold`, `stalled`, `blocked`, handled regressions, covered 040 issues and auto-mergeable PRs no longer appear under Needs human. A hive PR that only references an issue (`Refs #N`, no closing keyword) is recorded as *addressing part of* the issue instead of *covering* it, in the relay, the claim-ledger backfill and the stage reason/caption; a bare cross-reference such as a shared-CI incident deferral never creates a covering relation ([#15008](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15008)).
- A contributor PR with no linked issue no longer logs the "waits on the hive past the stage dwell — reviewer lane needs attention" warning; it is waiting on a person, not the reviewer lane (#15009)
- A busy hive whose reviewer lane is backed up no longer files a repeated unclassified runtime-error self-report for the one-shot "PR waits on the hive past the stage dwell" warning; the condition stays in the log and the dashboard's hive-held count ([#15009](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15009)).
- Stop the merge lanes from merging a PR whose merge would close the wrong thing: a body that says an issue stays open (`Refs #N — partial`) but also `Closes #N` is held as `closing-contradiction:#N` until the body is fixed, and a closing keyword in the body or a commit message that names another open pull request (`fix #1036`) holds the merge as `closing-keyword-targets-pr:#N`. Both gates apply only to PRs into the repository's default branch, the one place GitHub acts on closing keywords.
- Inference requests inherit a configured gateway default when the agent model is blank; if both are blank, Hive rejects the request locally and shows an actionable model configuration error instead of repeatedly sending an empty model to the provider ([#15032](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15032)).
- Re-checking a parked issue no longer spends a copy lookup on the hive's own adoption copy when that copy closed unmerged and refers to the issue.
- Fast delegated decisions now settle their operator-action ledger entries reliably instead of leaving the activity monitor badge pending forever ([#15064](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15064)).
- Inference requests canceled by the caller no longer report a backend failure or count against gateway health. (#15083)
- Contributor auto-promotion now remembers each author's merged-repository search for an hour (a failed search for 15 minutes) instead of searching again on every sweep ([#15088](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15088)).
- Avoid repeated contributor auto-promotion searches within a sweep and skip bot authors ([#15088](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15088)).
- Inception uses its local knowledge wiki without warning about an unconfigured remote project endpoint, while retaining warnings for configured endpoint failures ([#15098](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15098)).
- The merge-eligible list no longer includes contributor PRs the merge relay's contributor-lane policy refuses (for example newcomer-tier authors), so agents stop wasting a `hive merge` attempt on them every kick ([#15093](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15093), [#15129](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/pull/15129)).
- Rebase-then-merge refuses workflow-changing fork rebases before dispatching a fixer push the App cannot complete, and asks for a human rebase instead of timing out ([#15133](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15133)).
- Dashboard chat no longer goes silent after sending a command when a background poll stalls: each `/api/chat/messages` poll now times out after 10 s, and a poll requested while another is in flight (such as the one after `!inception reset`) runs as soon as it finishes instead of being dropped ([#15137](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15137)).
- Close issues fixed by contributor PRs merged by the hive, including merges into non-default release branches, so covered-by-PR stage labels and activity rows do not remain stale ([#15148](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15148)).
- Clear blockers when issues close through GitHub or the hive, so closed issues no longer inflate the capabilities blocked-item count ([#15155](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15155)).
- Contributor PRs skipped for missing or unverified claims and other admission failures no longer read as waiting on the hive reviewer or trigger its dwell warning; running checks still count as waiting on the hive ([#15164](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15164)).
- Dashboard evidence heartbeat refreshes now use the evidence root captured when the heartbeat starts, preventing a background data race when the default root changes ([#15169](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15169)).
- fix(crux): make shared-pool watcher tests deterministic (#15172)
- *Let hive decide* on an untrusted author's PR at *Ready for human merge* now decides instead of answering "I can't merge this": a reviewed, green, mergeable PR is approved for the merge sweep to merge under its own number, and only a red, conflicting or unreviewed PR is adopted; the ✓ hover names the path and reason (#15173)
- fix(crux): split oversized files under the mirror's file-size ratchet and gate src/crux in hive CI (#15207)
- Re-adopting a pull request after the hive closed its earlier copy now merges the base branch into the new copy again, so the fresh copy no longer opens with the conflict the first adoption had resolved ([#15225](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15225)).
- The dashboard's review-evidence loader no longer falls back to the package-wide evidence root from a background goroutine; every caller already resolves the root before loading, so behaviour is unchanged and a blanked root can no longer reintroduce the data race fixed earlier ([#15258](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15258)).
- The Activity Monitor's merged toasts now render above the chat button: the `--z-merge-banner` / `--z-cue-flight` layer tokens were scoped to the section while the toast stack mounts on `<body>`, so the stack had no z-index and the chat FAB covered the lowest toast's close × and truncated its text ([#15288](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15288)).
- Clarify that Overview counts open issues and PRs while the Hive activity monitor counts rows, showing how many PRs stand alone or share an issue row.
- The fleet self-report feed's diagnostics excerpt is now bounded at 4096 bytes instead of 512: the `agent-runtime` "pane content at timeout" warning logs a `head_500` attribute before `tail_500`, and at the old cap `head_500` alone (worse with multi-byte box-drawing characters) filled the budget and silently dropped `tail_500` — the pane's current state and the only field useful for diagnosing a stuck CLI — every time the warning fired. Self-reports for `agent_pane_timeout` now carry a usable excerpt ([#15311](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15311), [#14586](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14586)).
- The repeated-error feed no longer files the "kick undeliverable; busy-no-activity restart not yet attempted, not self-reporting" warning as a fleet issue; kicks that keep failing after the stall restart are still reported ([#15313](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15313)).
- Fixed stale `src/pkg/` source citations in labels-and-control-signals.md and security-model.md that now point at `src/crux/` (#15318).
- Bound crash and consent-screen recovery before agent kicks with the shared restart-storm breaker, backing off repeated failures and pausing agents at the storm limit instead of restarting indefinitely.
- Repeated inference translator caller-identification refusals now report as `inference_caller_unidentified` under the inference gateway, with medium severity, instead of `unclassified_error_repeated`; the HTTP 401 identity guard remains enforced (#15333).
- fix: stop retrying shared-ci reruns the App may not perform (#15339)
- Restart-storm self-reports now carry the restart count in the window, the recent restart reasons and the agent's last error instead of repeating the title, so a paused crash loop can be triaged from the issue (hivecommons/hive#15342).
- Re-engagement kicks deferred by a busy shared CLI session pool remain in local logs without generating repeated runtime-error self-reports; undelivered kicks still consume no repair budget.
- Defer remaining PR-claim link work after GitHub rate limits and log the expected retry without triggering repeated-error self-reports.
- The issue stage-label sweep no longer emits one `PR issue-link safeguard failed` WARN per (issue, PR) pair while GitHub's secondary rate limit is active. The first rate-limited PR lookup pauses the safeguard for the rest of the sweep and one summary line records it, so the self-report feed stops filing `unclassified_error_repeated` fleet issues for it ([#15359](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15359)).
- Downgrade expected GitHub rate-limit errors during PR claim label reconciliation to informational logs.
- Stop filing `unclassified_error_repeated` self-reports for GitHub 502/503/504 transient failures (e.g. the self-authored automerge sweep's `fetch-pr` skip); the caller retries on its next tick and the WARN stays in local logs ([#15365](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15365)).
- Avoid reporting transient GitHub gateway failures embedded in log messages as repeated runtime errors.
- Log lines that merely mention "bad gateway", "service unavailable" or "gateway timeout" in prose are no longer classified as GitHub upstream-unavailable errors; only the `: <status>` forms match (#15370).
- A contributor review gate no longer emits repeated warnings before the first verdict exists; missing verdicts still prevent automatic approval.
- Path globs with a `**/` prefix and a second glob character, such as `**/*luks*` or `files/**/*luks*`, now match by basename at any depth instead of silently matching nothing. The shared matcher backs `intent.guardrail_path_patterns`, `auto_merge.human_merge_paths` and `sentinel.sensitive_paths`, so those gates were disarmed for such patterns; `**/*.ext` patterns behave as before ([#15386](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15386)).
- The selfreport classifier now recognises the proxy's `plain HTTP forward refused — destination is not globally routable` WARN as its own log-fed class, `proxy_plain_forward_refused`, instead of letting repeats fall into the generic `unclassified_error_repeated` issue. The refusal is an expected policy decision (a client ignored its proxy bypass for a private address) and is still counted as a violation. (#15391)
- The queued auto-merge lane now remembers GitHub's "required status checks are expected" merge refusal per head, like the other lanes, instead of re-PUTting the merge every sweep pass and logging a false merge-failed ([#15419](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15419)).
- Fix the tracker holder tooltip to identify local claims as coming from the claim ledger.
- Agents now bypass the hive proxy for the host of `OMP_AUTH_BROKER_URL` (added to `NO_PROXY`), so a credential broker on a private address such as the Docker bridge gateway is no longer refused by the plain-forward guard and the agent CLI no longer exits on start ([#15432](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15432)).
- A combined review head's fan-out now splits the shared grounding tool-call budget across its per-perspective sub-agents instead of leaving each to read the whole-review cap as its own.
- fix(dashboard): share the PR link → lineage → base-pill assembly between tracker row renderers; correct the tracker.css shrink-priority comment (#15447, #15451)
- A kick ref withheld because the GitHub API budget is critical or the rate-limit caution window is engaged is now logged at INFO instead of WARN, so the designed back-off no longer files an `unclassified_error_repeated` self-report ([#15465](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15465)).
- fix(hotspot): stop proposing source splits for generated files whose source is already split (#15471)
- Cache the dashboard tracker’s unfiltered issue closer once per issue and exclude the carrying PR per row, preserving correct sibling links without extra lookups. This defensively preserves correct links if merged PR rows are included; current open-only tracker behavior is unchanged ([#15495](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15495)).
- Fixed a flaky claim-hook test that let the label-release hook keep writing after the test finished by letting hooks run on a caller-supplied effect queue that tests can drain (#15520)
- Fix an extra separator before the base branch in dashboard issue rows when PR lineage is empty.
- Isolate TestFetchWebhookItemSnapshot_ClassifiesForGovernor from rate-limit caution left by earlier tests ([#15535](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15535)).
- Dashboard settings help marks for the auto-merge, label-driven approval, sentinel, GitHub API budget and Delivery SLA settings now open the operator-reference section that explains them instead of the index page.
- A review-heads decision verdict no longer records as an advisory, undecided report when other review kicks in the same pass are delivered first, so the decision is not left to expire and run again; a verdict that falls back to advisory despite its agent having dispatch rows for the PR now logs the rows it was compared with ([#15559](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15559)).
- The "review dispatch promoted" warning is now logged once per PR while it stays promoted instead of every cycle, so it no longer trips the repeated-unclassified-error self-report ([#15578](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15578)).
- Activity tracker: the lit chevron no longer says "Merge queued · 1st" for a PR whose CI is still running or whose review verdict is pending ([#15580](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15580)). The headline is stage-first ("CI / Review"), the merge-train slot becomes a trailing suffix ("· queued 1st once ready") until the PR reaches merge-ready, the gate reason reads "merges first once it is ready", and the server marks such train members `merge_train.provisional: true`.
- Empty-diff autoclose head age is floored at the PR's `created_at`, so a PR just opened from an old branch keeps its just-opened grace period, and a head already on the base is measured from its own commit date rather than the label-bumped `updated_at` ([#15603](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15603))
- When an issue has multiple merged same-repository pull request references, Hive now selects the most recently merged closer instead of depending on GitHub's node order ([#15606](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15606)).
- The Activity Monitor's "Merge failed" chevron is scoped to the head GitHub refused: once the PR head moves (merge-from-base, new push) or the record falls back below 080 to wait on CI after the refusal, the chevron reads the live stage word and the refusal survives only as the hover note "merge attempt on previous head failed: branch protection", so the chevron and its caption never disagree about whether a merge is failing now ([#15611](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15611)).
- A kick withheld because every ref failed the freshness check is now reported under its own fleet-report class instead of the generic unclassified-error class ([#15622](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15622)).
- Dashboard: the scroll-edge fade at the bottom of scrollable dialog bodies (Settings and other long modals) now follows the theme — in light mode it fades to the light panel surface instead of painting a dark band over the last visible row; dark mode is unchanged ([#15625](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15625)).
- The merge-hotspot advisor now caps the modularize issues it keeps open per repo (`governor.hotspot_max_open`, default 2; issues with a PR in flight still count) and files at most `governor.hotspot_max_per_pass` (default 1) per pass, filing the next-ranked hotspot only when a slot frees instead of opening five refactor issues in one pass ([#15682](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15682)).
- Label descriptions Hive writes to GitHub now fit the 100-character cap: the over-long `origin/governor`, `origin/selfreport` and `has-open-pr` descriptions were shortened and every label create/edit clamps the description, so `CreateIssue` no longer logs `could not ensure label … 422 description is too long` and drops the `origin/*` provenance label ([#15683](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15683), [#15681](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15681)).
- fix: page through every closing PR reference when picking the latest merged closer (#15687)
- Already-landed auto-close now posts its "this issue is done" note only after the issue close goes through, so an issue that CloseIssue's tracking-issue or reporter-confirmation gate keeps open no longer carries a misleading note ([#15689](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15689))
- A stage/072 row under `maintainer_policy: never` no longer claims `hive adopts it in Nm` right up to the due moment for a maintainer's own PR, only to flip to `not adopted: maintainer_policy is never`: the engine does not read the author's repository permission until adoption is due, so the tracker names the exception (`unless the author maintains this repository`) instead of promising an outcome it cannot back for every author.
- The stage pass now posts the merge-commit note only after the `merge-method/merge` label actually landed; when the write-back gate keeps the hive's labels off a contributor PR, the election is refused with that reason and the PR takes the attribution fallback (re-home, or the stage/085 note naming the gate) instead of being told "nobody needs to act" while the squash-attribution check stays red ([#15710](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15710)).
- Show the standby tile ("scanner — paused, out of budget. 1 waiting, 0 qualify." plus its dispatch button) in the Governor section whenever a lane is paused. It used to render only into the compact governor strip, which CSS always hides, so operators could not see or act on paused lanes from the dashboard ([#15720](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15720)).
- Standby dispatch and clear no longer return 403 for a logged-in owner on a self-hosted hive: the session role is now resolved on public `/api/contribute/` routes when no hub proxy proof is present (#15723).
- The already-landed close now covers any author's PR, not only the hive's own: when the diff against the base is empty and a merged PR provably carries the change (the reviewer named it and it is merged, the linked issue was closed by a merged PR, or the head is contained in the base) the PR is closed as superseded with thanks instead of parking at 085 for a person; trusted authors are treated the same, and the "Let hive decide" preview gives the empty diff and the merged landing as its reason rather than the author's trust ([#15732](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15732))
- A stage/072 row under `maintainer_policy: ask` no longer claims `hive adopts it in Nm` right up to the due moment for a maintainer's own PR, only to flip to `adopt?`: the engine does not read the author's repository permission until adoption is due, so the tracker names the exception (`unless the author maintains this repository, then it asks`), the same hedge `never` got in #15738.
- Hive-authored PRs whose review fix dispatch is refused with `fix-attempts-exhausted` now move from `stage/070-fixing` to `stage/085-needs-decision` (reason `fixer-exhausted:<N>`) with a `fixer gave up after N attempts — <reviewer finding>` caption, a once-per-head decision comment and **Re-author** as the tracker's lead action; a 070 row no longer claims `Fixing · @bot` while no fix job is dispatched, a stale answered decision no longer clears `stage/stalled` while the fixer is excluded and the head is unchanged, and the `review fix dispatch excluded` warning is logged once per PR head instead of every cycle ([#15744](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15744)).
- A recorded operator decision (dashboard Approve, `/hive decision …`) now follows a hive-authored PR onto the head the hive's own `require_current_base` refresh produced — a merge of the base by the App that leaves the PR's diff identical — so the reviewer route reads `decision_answered=true` instead of re-parking the PR at `stage/085-needs-decision`, and the review gate and hold guard accept the carried approval. Any other head change still supersedes the decision ([#15751](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15751)).
- The stage tracker's "Hive:" note for a soaking PR no longer re-stamps itself every eval pass. The contributor lane records the soak head, start and window once on the stage record and reports the stable reason `contributor-lane:soaking`; the dashboard computes the time left from that deadline at request time (showing `soak complete — merges on the next pass` at the deadline instead of `0s left`), sends an explicit `note_changed_at`, and the SPA refreshes the countdown in place rather than opening a new line. `LastSeen` no longer counts as a record change and is persisted at most once per 10 minutes. Records written with the old `contributor-lane:soaking(remaining=…)` reason stay readable (#15758).
- Fixed the reconcile (enumerate) pass being starved by wake-driven cached cycles: a wake whose cached snapshot is older than the effective eval interval now enumerates, and the loop runs an owed reconcile pass regardless of which channel woke it, so the snapshot can no longer age for an hour while the ticker tick loses to webhook, verdict and re-kick wakes. The stage tracker's "since" for an issue the blocked sweep just unblocked now restarts at the lift instead of counting from issue creation ([#15779](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15779)).
- Activity monitor: "⟳ Mergeable · merging now ⬡" no longer lingers for minutes — the sweep clock now marks only the PR actually under evaluation, and a merge call that returns patches the cached snapshot and nudges the SPA at once, so the row reaches ✓ within one poll. Every hive-performed merge (trusted-author, self-authored, contributor and stage-engine lanes alike) celebrates exactly once — toast with the PR number, bee flight, odometer +1 after landing — even when the row vanished before the SPA saw the merged state (reconciled by `recently_merged` / `recently_closed` on removal) — a merge whose row is not on the board (below the fold, filtered, already evicted; #15707) now flies its bee from the toast's ✓ to the counter instead of skipping bee and odometer; a row that vanishes because its PR was closed, not merged, shows a neutral "#N closed · <reason>" toast instead of disappearing silently. The merge-gate "Merging · merge landed" bridge is now a ceiling, not a fixed delay: `dashboard.stage_tracker.merged_hold_s` (default `8`, min `3`), with the celebration launching as soon as the merged fact arrives; a merge call or sweep in flight for over 60 s reads "merging · waiting for GitHub…" ([#15808](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15808)).
- Repeated inference messages are no longer self-reported as `unclassified_error_repeated`: spending-limit refusals are benign because the budget notice and kick withholding already cover them ([#15809](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15809)), the kick manager's own provider-error backoff is benign ([#15843](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15843)), and `inference translate request failed` now lands under `inference_upstream_error` ([#15840](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15840)).
- Review verdicts that land after a PR head moved are now accepted against the current head when the reviewer reviewed the live head or the new head is the same patch (rebase/merge-from-base), reviewer-role agents bind to a sibling reviewer's dispatch row, in-flight dispatch rows follow same-patch head moves instead of being re-dispatched, reviewer slots go to merge-ready PRs first (then starved heads, then age; pending-CI heads only with spare capacity, `priority` in the dispatch log), and the audit kick preview skips the security-canary preamble so operators see the real work ([#15823](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15823))
- The merge train now seats only PRs whose current head is green with every required review verdict recorded, mergeable and not held; a PR short of that is a candidate without a position and never the front. A member whose head moves, whose CI goes pending or red, who owes a verdict again or who conflicts is ejected on the next evaluation (`merge train: member ejected pr=N why=…`), the next ready member fronts, and the ejected PR re-enters at the back once ready. The stage engine and the Activity Monitor keep such PRs below stage 080 — in the CI / Review column, never the Merge queue column — with a caption naming what is owed and a gray "left merge train" lineage pill. A member being rebased shows "Rebasing · attempt 1/2" in the CI / Review column; the train header counts seated members only; a seated row always names its seat rather than "Ready for auto merge · checking now", which now applies only to the PR the sweep is evaluating ([#15825](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15825)).
- The Governor RUNNING tile no longer shows a stray dot between "$" and the amount ("$.1,010") or clips the cost window label: the host's text-overflow ellipsis was being painted under the "$" when the agent count plus the cost rotor overflowed the tile. The tile is now a flex row whose rotor shrinks and ellipsizes on its own, window labels are shorter ("this hr", "today", "this wk", "this mo"), and the today / week / month amounts round to whole dollars while the hour window keeps cents ([#15826](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15826)).
- Activity monitor merge notifications survive reloads without replaying delivered merges, resolve audit events for vanished rows, and cancel their countdown when evicted from the banner stack.
- dashboard: merge banners drain the toast countdown bar (#15880)
- CEL trigger rules on `issue.opened` and `pr.opened` now match each issue or PR once per hive process instead of re-kicking the agent every eval cycle.
- celtrigger: fire issue.opened and pr.opened once per item (#15889)
- dashboard: point operator-reference help marks at the section sub-pages (#15890)
- fix: tighten a pre-existing base-preparation directory to the intended mode (#15897)
- Tool approval now flags `rm -rf /..`, `rm -rf /./`, `rm -rf /./*` and `rm -rf ~/.` as destructive, matching the documented root/home spellings (#15952)
- The built-in destructive-command check now reads `rm` arguments the way `rm` does, so `rm -rf --no-preserve-root /` (the spelling GNU rm actually executes against the root), `rm -rf -- /`, `rm --recursive --force /`, `rm -r --force ~` and `rm -rfv /` are flagged like `rm -rf /` instead of passing clean to the host text scanner ([#15961](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15961)). Option order, long options and `--` no longer matter; ordinary subpaths (`rm -rf -- /tmp/x`) and non-recursive `rm` still pass.
- Matrix lines that look like short `key=value` secrets (for example `password: hunter2`) are now dropped, and `Server.Close` now stops the Matrix line source goroutine (#15971, #15972).
- Matrix `GET /api/matrix/lines` now applies `max` after per-repo allowlist filtering, so paging with `max` no longer returns empty pages (and stalls) when the oldest lines in the window belong to repos the caller cannot see.
- fix: resolve sentinel repo privacy from the repository record (#15980)
- The display-mode 🔗 Copy link control now keeps `density=tv` and `shift=1`, so a wall screen opened with `?display=1&density=tv&shift=1` no longer loses its TV layout and burn-in shift when the link is copied; the flags are rendering-only, so no token or cookie can ride along (#15983).
- Removing a hive from the hub registry now also drops its in-memory activity digest instead of keeping it for up to 24 hours (#16002).
- A heartbeat racing a hive delete can no longer re-insert an activity digest after the hive was forgotten; the digest is now recorded and purged under the same registry lock ([#16010](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16010)).
- An adopted (or otherwise hive-owned) conflicting PR no longer sits on "Rebasing · attempt 1/2" while the fixer is busy: each rebase attempt is routed once and gets `governor.labels.stage.adoption.rebase_attempt_timeout` (default 15m) to push before it counts as failed and the next attempt is dispatched, the row shows the wait ("Rebasing · attempt 1/2 · waiting for scanner 12m"), and an in-place adoption whose attempts are spent re-homes to a hive-owned superseding PR at once instead of after the 3h dwell ([#16023](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16023)).
- `hive-open-issue` requests that declare `--parent` or `--blocked-by` are no longer folded into an older open issue on a shared file path, component or canonical title stem, and the create's idempotency replay keys on the exact title so same-stem siblings citing one file each get their own issue; a genuine create reports `consolidation_skipped_reason` (`parent` or `blocked_by`) and the watcher logs the skip (#16065).
- A declared DAG request (`--parent`/`--blocked-by`) now still reuses an open review-backlog issue whose title differs only by the leading agent tag, instead of filing a duplicate (#16074).
- Self-upgrade drain now logs a single warning per pass listing every wedged agent kick it is ignoring, instead of one identical-keyed warning per agent. The fleet self-report feed keys WARNs on the message alone, so a hive with many wedged lanes was tripping a spurious `unclassified_error_repeated` report ([#16079](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16079)).
- An omp agent HOME without a sign-in no longer files a repeated fleet defect: both the per-HOME "omp model discovery found no models for this HOME" line and the all-homes-failed "omp model discovery unavailable, serving static fallback" line are logged at Info instead of Warn, matching the goose/agy/claude backends. A HOME with no sign-in contributes nothing by design, and the degraded-discovery transition is already audited once by the discovery tracker ([#16080](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16080)).
- RFC lifecycle notices now recognise an RFC issue whose title carries the RFC marker inside a leading bracketed tag (for example `📝 [v5 RFC] ...`), so newly opened RFCs written that way are posted to the RFC Discord channel and get a thread ([#16090](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16090)).
- RFC duplicate detection now ignores leading bracketed title tags such as `[v5 RFC]` or `[v6]`, so `📝 [v5 RFC] Foo` and `RFC: [v5] Foo` are recognised as duplicates of `RFC: Foo` by the same author.
- **A wedged tmux server can no longer stall the whole governor tick through the watchdog** ([#16097](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16097)). `watchdog.Reconciler.Tick` runs inline in the steady-state governor loop on the promise that every probe carries a deadline, but `WatchdogFleet.Observe` shelled out to `tmux has-session` and `tmux capture-pane` with no timeout — so one agent's hung tmux server (socket accepted, never answering) froze the eval cycle, rotation, automerge sweep and state persistence until tmux recovered or hive restarted, and shutdown could not interrupt it. Observe's tmux probes now share a short deadline (`agent.ObserveProbeTimeout`, 5s); a probe that times out reports the agent as unobservable for that sweep (never as "no session", which would trigger a restart), and `Tick` stops early once its context is cancelled. The `watchdog.Source` interface is unchanged.
- Expected hold-guard refusals for branches changed while held no longer generate repeated runtime-error fleet reports; local warnings and merge safety remain unchanged.
- The hold guard's "stopped keeping held PR mergeable until its head or base moves" warning is logged once per head, base and reason instead of on every pass.
- A held fork PR the hive cannot update now costs the process a single remembered stop instead of one per base-branch push, so long-running hives no longer accumulate that memory (#16106).
- The "merge train stalled" log line now repeats at most once per hour per stuck head PR, instead of once per planner train ID, so one stalled head no longer floods the log or files a repeated-error self-report ([#16107](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16107)).
- The anonymous `/api/hub/activity/public` view is now built and marshalled at most once per 2-second window per parsed filter and shared by concurrent requests: query strings that parse to the default view (`?x=1`, `?hive=`) share its entry, filtered views live in a small bounded cache, builds are serialised so anonymous callers can drive at most one at a time, the ETag comes from the cached body so conditional requests return 304 without a rebuild, and toggling a hive's visibility drops the cache so a hive made private disappears at once (#16111).
- Sentinel findings on pull requests no longer generate repeated runtime-error fleet reports; the local warning and the PR alert remain unchanged, and sentinel sweep failures stay reportable.
- Throughput card: the Actor attribution matrix's Reviewed row now counts reviews people and other bots submit (human and other columns), read once per PR by the merged-PR settle scan when the PR merges or closes and recorded as `pr_review_observed` at each review's `submitted_at`; the hive's own reviews are not double-counted and each review counts once across rescans and restarts (#16116)
- The public activity cache is now invalidated when a hive is deleted ([#16117](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16117)). Previously, deleted public hives remained visible in the anonymous `/api/hub/activity/public` endpoint for up to 2 seconds (the cache TTL) instead of disappearing immediately.
- A trusted merger's typed `/hive decision approve` on an owner-authored PR that touches no workflow file now answers the review swarm's `requires_human` question on the head from the contributor lane itself. Before, only the workflow-path fence release recorded the typed approval, so on any other PR the answer depended on the un-park sweep, which reads only PRs labelled `stage/085-needs-decision` or `stage/070-fixing`; an unlabelled PR sat at `contributor-lane:no-verdict`. The lane uses the same comment rule, trust check and record as the fence path, and a decision recorded on the head after the comment still stands.
- The `min_head_age` merge gate no longer stalls green merges for an hour when GitHub's server-generated timestamps (`created_at`/`updated_at`/`pushed_at`) run ahead of the host clock. A head time in the future is treated as clock skew: instead of clamping to "head pushed 0s ago" for the whole skew, the automerge sweep and the `hive-merge` CI gate measure the hold from the host-clock time they first observed the head (`pending: head time ahead of host clock; head first seen … ago (< min_head_age)`), so slow check-runs are still held for one `min_head_age` window and the hold then clears. Heads whose age is zero or positive still wait as before ([#16143](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16143)).
- Pushbroker newline normalisation now amends the normalised HEAD blob instead of the working-tree file, so uncommitted edits are never folded into the commit; staged edits to those paths are left unstaged after the amend. Broker git invocations now return stdout only on success (stderr is appended only on failure) and drop inherited `GIT_TRACE*`, so git warnings cannot be committed as file content (#16144, #16145)
- The merge-request CI gate now clears the min_head_age hold one window after it first sees a head whose GitHub timestamp is ahead of the host clock even when the merge request omits `expect_sha`, and both merge paths log when a head time is ahead of the host clock so a skew-handled head is distinguishable from a normally aged one.
- `hive-open-pr --issues 0` is now refused at the script (GitHub numbers issues from 1, so a `0` is the `<N>` placeholder left unsubstituted), and the pr-request watcher rejects a request that still declares `#0` by naming the placeholder as the cause instead of saying the body "never references" it — a remedy no re-run could satisfy, which had an agent retrying into five policy rejections in ten minutes ([#16162](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16162))
- Crux: `settledAt`, `since` and `expires_at` are now omitted from JSON when zero instead of serialising `0001-01-01T00:00:00Z` (#16165).
- Fleet report: an agent with no inference model configured (neither an agent model nor a gateway `default_model`) no longer self-reports `inference_upstream_error` — the inference translator now logs the refusal at WARN as `inference model not configured; request refused`, which the fleet report treats as an operator configuration condition; the agent's dashboard `LastError` still names the remedy, and other translation failures stay ERRORs under `inference_upstream_error` ([#16170](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16170)).
- `toolapprove` now denies recursive `rm` of the filesystem root written with backslash escapes (`rm -rf \/`, `rm -rf /\*`), matching the quoted spellings it already caught; `\$HOME` and `\~` stay literal and allowed ([#16174](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16174)).
- `toolapprove` now reads every backslash escape in an `rm` command word, option or target the way the shell does, so the alias-bypass `\rm -rf \/`, the escaped-dot root `rm -rf /\.` and the escaped or quoted options `rm \-rf /` and `rm "-rf" /` are denied like `rm -rf /`; `\$HOME` and `\~` stay literal and allowed ([#16176](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16176)).
- `crux --server` / `CRUX_SERVER` now keep a URL path prefix (e.g. `https://ops.example/crux`) instead of silently dropping it; a query string or userinfo in the address is rejected with an error (#16186)
- The signed-commit reconciler now gives up on a PR head after GitHub refuses to sign it (a 4xx such as the 422 on the scratch ref) on three consecutive passes and posts its skip note once, with a remedy that fits (push a new head), instead of retrying and re-logging the same error every pass; a 5xx or network failure is still retried every pass (#16193).
- Made the proxy C3 terminal-authorization tests hermetic so ambient `HIVE_*` keys and ingress settings on a host no longer cause spurious 401 failures ([#16194](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16194)).
- fix(pushbroker): the trailing-blank-line normaliser now keeps an agent's staged (index) state for a touched path. `git add` of the normalised blob used to replace the staged entry, so an uncommitted edit the agent had already staged came back on disk but silently unstaged; the broker now snapshots the index entry and puts it back with `git update-index --cacheinfo` after the amend (#16158, #16196).
- The automerge sweep now logs the "install the ok-to-test workflow" approval warning once per PR head instead of every tick ([#16199](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16199)).
- Proxy test suite: `startProxy()` now spawns the proxy with `hermeticEnv()` so ambient `HIVE_*` auth vars on the runner cannot flip `IS_HOSTED` for the main suite ([#16203](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16203)).
- fix(github): note signed-reconciler refusal path in errMissingHead doc (#16207)
- A relay that echoes a stale task generation on `task_progress` is now told to release the task (`task_revoke`) instead of being silently fenced, so a relay that missed its revoke stops reporting and the hub stops logging the repeated "stale-generation task_progress rejected" warning ([#16218](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16218)).
- On Linux, permissions watcher chown/chmod errors now name the entry's path instead of its `/proc/self/fd/N` link, so operator greps on the `error` field match the `path` field and the #4488 once-at-WARN dedupe keys on a stable path ([#4488](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/4488)).
- `just contribute-hive <backend> local` now launches the CLI with `AGENT_MODEL` and `AGENT_REASONING_EFFORT` ([#16222](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16222)). The local launch line added `--model` only for litellm and pi and never added an effort flag, and the relay reuses that line verbatim on every relaunch — so a claude contributor who asked for `claude-sonnet-5-5` at `medium` ran their Claude Code default (`xhigh` from `~/.claude/settings.json`) for the whole session, while the relay still reported the requested model and effort to the hub. Standby model tiers and the PR attribution trailer read that report. The launcher now takes both flags from `backend_selection_flags_shell` in `config/backends.conf`, which emits exactly what the relay's own builder adds (claude `--effort`, codex `-c model_reasoning_effort`, agy `--effort` with its model, muse `--reasoning-effort`, `--model` for every backend that takes one). The relay also reports a model or effort only when the launch line carries its flag, and logs once when it does not, so the hub never records a configuration the CLI is not running.
- The merge-request watcher now treats GitHub's "Changes must be made through the merge queue" 405 as terminal: it stops retrying the direct merge and logs one classified message per PR head instead of repeated warnings. (#16229)
- The spoke's hub activity digest (and Battle Log / Hive of the Week) now treats a public hive's own project repos as public again: config loading strips the org off `project.repos` and `primary_repo`, and the public repo set rejected the bare names, so every item was marked private and the hub's public fleet view showed "0 items" for every hive ([#16234](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16234)).
- The sentinel's patch observation now names the repository as `owner/name` instead of the configured slug (a bare name once config loading strips the org), so `dashboard.matrix.repos` entries match and the Matrix view receives pushed lines instead of waiting forever; the repo privacy fallback lookup uses the same owner/name ([#16235](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16235)).
- Merged-PR claim scan timeouts are now treated as transient and logged once per repo instead of a repeated warning on every tick (#16244)
- fix(toolapprove): treat positional parameters and empty substitutions glued to protected paths as protected targets (#16245, #16320)
- Hive-authored draft PRs carrying only prow's `do-not-merge/work-in-progress` mirror label are no longer filtered as "Exempt label" before the stale-draft rule runs, so deferred drafts surface in the scanner's "YOUR STALE DRAFT PRs" section instead of deadlocking with their `covered_by_open_pr` issue (#16246).
- All hive:status comment writers go through one serialised writer with compare-and-retry and duplicate reconciliation, so concurrent writers no longer lose sections or create duplicate status comments (#16263).
- Stop the permissions watcher from re-logging an unfixable (EPERM) chmod of bob's `.bob` state dir at ERROR every pass: skip dirs owned by another uid, and warn once with an ownership hint.
- Open-PR guard bounds its listing deadline and backs off per repo after a failure, logging a classified reason once per window (#16287)
- The copilot transcript activity scan overrun warning is now debounced: it fires once after three consecutive passes longer than the scan interval and re-arms only after a pass under 80% of it, so a marginal overrun on a many-agent hive no longer logs a WARN every ~25s and trips the fleet report ([#16292](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16292)).
- Agent launch commands never emit a bare `--model` for an empty model: the flag is omitted (or falls back to `litellm.default_model` when LiteLLM is configured, with a one-time WARN), a launch-time check drops a dangling `--model` that would swallow the next flag, and the kick path now recognises Claude Code permission dialogs ("Read outside the working directories?"), auto-answers them when the agent runs with `--dangerously-skip-permissions`, and reports `CLI blocked on permission dialog: <dialog>` instead of "did not reach input prompt" ([#16295](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16295)).
- Merge-queue-required refusals now raise an operator dashboard alert: `quarantineMergeQueueRequired` calls `raiseMergeFailureAlert`, and `classifyMergeFailureForOperator` gains a `merge-queue-required` category telling the operator to enqueue the PR via the merge queue, merge by hand, or drop the rule. Previously the 405 "Changes must be made through the merge queue" was only logged at INFO and never surfaced (#16322).
- fix(attention): release the episode store lock during GitHub delivery calls and prune resolved items so the ledger never fails closed (#16327, #16332)
- fix(automerge): route the engine status-comment create through the tagged notification primitive (#16344)
- `prstatus.Write` now edits only hive-authored status comments: a status marker pasted by a person is merged from but left in place, and a new hive-owned comment is created when none exists ([#16345](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16345)).
- fix(prstatus): only treat status comments by this hive's own App login as editable or deletable (#16348)
- fix(github): a merge-queue-required operator alert now clears on its own once the base branch's rules no longer include a merge queue, instead of lingering until the PR closes (#16350)
- The post-merge refs sweep no longer treats an unreadable `hive:status` card as "no card": when the comments API call fails or returns something other than a JSON list of comments, `.github/scripts/hive-status-card.sh` now reports an error (exit 3) instead of absence, `upsert` writes nothing, and the sweep skips that issue with an `::error::` annotation and a non-zero exit rather than posting a possible duplicate note ([#16363](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16363)).
- Reconciling a stuck GitHub label mutation (e.g. removing issue-claim labels) no longer fails with "context deadline exceeded" when the preceding read used up the attempt budget, so the claim retry loop stops repeating "op:… is Planned" until the entry ages out.
- Route normal-mode PR stage notes through the canary gate and effects journal used by other issue comments.
- The `stage/085-needs-decision` entry comment is no longer posted again on the same head when a different automerge lane observes the PR; maintainers get one explanation per decision ([#16405](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16405)).
- Count standby qualification against the same lane-specific dispatchable queue used by standby dispatch.
- Large task prompts (such as ~55 KB donated standby prompts) are no longer lost on claude relays: prompts over 8192 bytes are pasted through a tmux buffer, and a prompt that still cannot be delivered is reported to the hub as `task_failed` (#16423).
- The process-wide webhook tracker is now swapped and read atomically, removing a data race that failed `TestClosedDeliveryEvictsWithWebhookRefreshDisabled` under `-race` when a refresher flush from an earlier test was still reading it ([#16429](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16429)).
- A spoke that boots from the ConfigMap seed (runtime overlay moved aside or missing) no longer drops `review.require_labels`, `project.paused_repos`, `writeback.per_repo` or `project.issue_filter.require_labels` in silence: each gate a previous overlay on the PVC carried that the effective config lacks or loosens is logged as `WARN safety gate dropped` with its previous value, listed in `/api/status` as `config.gate_regressions`, and shown as a Settings banner; `config.refuse_gate_regression: true` refuses to start instead.
- Fixed `manual-provisioning.md` to name the `hive.hivecommons.dev/*` namespace identity labels and annotation the hub actually stamps, instead of the legacy `hive.kubestellar.io/*` keys (#16459).
- The Activity Monitor tracker strip now shows a flask glyph for the CI track and keeps the eye for the Review track, so the two adjacent chevrons are no longer identical ([#16472](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16472)).
- Activity Monitor CI track captions now explain themselves in plain language — `CI waiting · required check "test" hasn't reported for this head yet`, `CI running · 3/5 checks done`, `CI failing · "lint" red`, `CI green · all 3 required checks passed` — and each carries a longer explanation in the chevron tooltip via a new `detail` field; the fix-task CI-wait and CI-retry captions were reworded the same way ([#16479](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16479)).
- The activity monitor no longer shows a decomposed parent issue that is waiting on open child issues as a stuck *Actionable* row "waiting for the scanner to pick it up": the lit step reads `Tracking · 3/4` (or `Tracking · N open children`), the caption and actor name the open children, and the item carries `open_children` ([#16481](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16481)).
- Activity monitor tracker rows are compact again: the stage chevrons sit directly under the title line as a one-line (~20px) strip, the issue title stays inline after its chips instead of dropping to its own line, the row toolbar pills share that first line, and row padding is tightened — roughly 60px per simple row as before the two-line chevron budget ([#16485](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16485)).
- The inference translator's "unidentified caller refused" warning now records why the caller was unidentified (no UID map, unresolved socket, or unmapped UID), the socket owner UID, and whether an `x-api-key` was sent; the refusal itself is unchanged ([#16474](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16474)).
- The Activity Monitor's CI and Review chevrons now show counts instead of a bare glyph or a muted tint: `CI 12/14 passed`, `CI 11/14 · 1 failing (lint)`, `CI 0/14 · queued`, `Review 3/5 perspectives`, `Review 5/5 approved`, `Review 0/5 · re-review pending (new head)`. A track in progress on the current head wears the full active fill (both may be lit at once — the counts disambiguate, and the tooltip says which one the hive is waiting on), a finished track wears the done style, a red check or changes-requested verdict wears the error colour, and only a not-yet-started track is a glyph alone. The server now reports `checks_passed/total/failed/failing` and `perspectives_done/total` on every CI/Review activity ([#16493](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16493)).
- Contributor assignments that race with an already-sent WebSocket close frame still release their undelivered claim, but now log at INFO instead of triggering repeated-error self-reports.
- Bound spoke cluster-health collection with a shared deadline so slow Kubernetes APIs return partial health reports without exhausting the hub heartbeat collection budget ([#16501](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16501)).
- Heartbeat loops no longer accumulate blocked full or fresh-stats collectors after repeated collection timeouts; fallback liveness beats continue, and timeout self-reports include the slowest collector sections.
- Stop filing duplicate unclassified self-reports for the hub heartbeat's last-good cached stats fallback; retain local warnings and fleet reporting of collector timeouts, slow collectors, and heartbeat failures ([#16507](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16507)).
- The claim-release valve no longer drops a covered issue to `stage/010-actionable` while the hive is still repairing its red covering PR ([#16522](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16522)). A red+stale PR releases its issue only once the fix loop has given up on that head: escalated to a human, re-engagement budget spent, or red for the whole re-engagement window (`escalation.ClaimReleaseAfter`) with no owner reachable. Until then the issue stays `stage/040-covered-by-pr` narrating the PR's `070-fixing`, and the scanner is not offered work a live PR already owns.
- Add opt-in ordered fixer fallback agents, configurable in Settings, so review fixes and stale red-PR repairs can bypass an undeliverable primary without interrupting its turn ([#16536](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16536)).
- Deferred PR fix kicks now retain their queue position until delivery or closure; the governor API exposes the queue and the dashboard review queue shows “fixer queued, N ahead” ([#16537](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16537)).
- The code activity reader now accepts unchanged diff context lines (`op: ' '`) from a regions source and renders them in a neutral color with their space prefix, instead of dropping the whole region; the current published-checkpoint source still emits only `+`/`-` lines ([#16550](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16550)).
- Activity Monitor stage chevrons are a one-line band again on phones and touch tablets; the chevron's info wrapper no longer inherits the 40px tap-target floor (and ring) that made every chevron a 44px box ([#16551](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16551)).
- The Activity Monitor keeps the CI track lit on a 071/072 row whose pushed or checking head has checks running, instead of muting it as waiting on the contributor ([#16552](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16552)).
- Stage controller: an issue a maintainer already decided (`approved-direction`) whose remaining work is human-only (`needs-human`) is no longer re-parked on `stage/045-needs-decision` with the ack stripped; it keeps `approved-direction` and is held out of the pipeline, ending the decide → re-park bounce loop; a newer, different `/hive decision` still lets an agent's park through and clears the stale ack ([#16579](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16579)).
- Activity Monitor: a sign-off question naming `@clubanderson-bot` or `@clubandersonx` no longer reads "needs your sign-off" to the viewer `clubanderson`; the viewer's handle is matched on a word boundary.
- The automerge sweep reuses the stored re-author target on retry passes instead of fetching the exhausted PR's closing issue from GitHub each pass ([#16586](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16586)).
- Stop-polling nudges no longer leave a `ci_poll_nudge` fleet report marked unrecovered: the next kick after a nudge now closes it as self-recovered, so the report stops accusing a healthy agent of being stuck ([#16588](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16588)).
- The un-park sweep no longer posts the "What to reply" notice or the `/hive approve` hint on an issue held after a human decision (`needs-human` + `approved-direction`, no stage/045), while still answering `/hive decision`, `/hive help` and `/fixed` on it ([#16591](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16591)).
- fix(github): log expected author self-approval verdict refusals at INFO instead of WARN so they no longer surface in repeated-error self-reports (#16605)
- Keep a not-yet-run current-phase CI/Review chevron visibly filled (#16625)
- Merged ledger writes no longer fail with "rename ... no such file or directory" when two writers race on the same temp file (#16629).
- Hub SHA poller backs off all commit-message fetches on a 403/429 and warns once per throttle window instead of once per SHA, so a rate-limited token no longer trips the `sha_poll_commit_message_unavailable` fleet report ([#16649](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16649)).
- Opening a hosted hive from the hub when the hive cannot verify the hub's single sign-on now shows the "Sign-in didn't complete" page with a GitHub sign-in button, instead of being replaced by the gateway's "Hive is restarting" outage page ([#16652](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16652)).
- Label the narrow dashboard's navigation drawer button so operators can find sidebar sections and version details without guessing what the menu icon does (#16654).
- API reference now lists the check-count and perspective fields of stage-tracker activity observations ([#16670](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16670)).
- Clarify the `StageTrackerActivity` source documentation: CI activity uses the resolved required checks when branch protection is known, otherwise all check runs observed on the head. This corrects the description without changing runtime behavior ([#16674](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/pull/16674)).
- In-place DCO repair no longer appends the App's Signed-off-by to a collaborator's unsigned commit on a hive-authored PR: only commits GitHub links to the App bot or a hive identity are re-signed, and a hive-authored PR carrying anyone else's unsigned commit waits for a person instead ([#16685](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16685)).
- Honor ntfy Retry-After deadlines and use bounded exponential cooldowns after HTTP 429 without a usable header, while Slack and Discord delivery continue independently.
- A decision park that defers to another issue's decision ("Answer on #N; the same choice applies here") now takes that answer when the owner decides #N with `/hive approve` or `/hive decision`: its decision label comes off — with a note saying where it was answered unless the repo's `writeback.per_repo[<repo>].mode` is `off` — instead of the issue coming back as a second ask with the same question once #N is unparked or closed (#16699). Only a genuine deferral inherits: the body must defer to #N in so many words, #N must itself have been a decision park, and `/hive done` or a release approval on #N leaves the deferring park its own ask; the inherited un-park counts against the pass's action cap.
- All five quality policies distinguish prohibited work discovery from merged PR history reads, which remain conditional on wrapper and tier permissions ([#16700](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16700), [#16715](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16715)).
- A DCO split cached while no `project.ai_author` was configured is no longer treated as computed with the hive identity, so configuring it later re-reads the commits for in-flight heads ([#16707](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16707)).
- Log the ntfy error-dedupe summary at INFO so a sustained ntfy outage no longer files a second unclassified_error_repeated selfreport for the summary line itself (#16708).
- A stale hive-identity DCO marker is now cleared when a new head is cached App-only, so re-adding `ai_author` after removing it re-reads the commit check instead of serving the App-only split ([#16710](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16710)).
- Kick headers now describe merged PR history reads as conditional on wrapper and tier permissions while preserving governor-supplied work and discovery restrictions ([#16714](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16714)).
- Staff agents can now list a repo's merged pull requests with `gh pr list --state merged` (any `--json` fields, no `--search`). Before, the gh wrapper refused every `gh pr list` from a non-contributor agent, so ci-maintainer could not run a repo's own agent-audit script (`gh pr list --state merged --json … | node scripts/ai-audit-report.mjs`) and parked "open the run summary and say which PR it flags" for the owner. Merged PRs are not work to pick, and the same set was already readable through `gh search prs --merged` and a GET of `repos/<owner>/<repo>/pulls`. Open, closed, all and `--search` listings stay refused, and the refusal now names the reads that still work.
- Contributor PRs with hive attribution now pass the merge relay's trust gate before being listed merge-eligible; trust refusals appear separately with their reason and maintainer unblock options ([#16717](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16717)).
- Decouple the crux sidecar probe deadline from the poll interval so a fast test ticker no longer reports a live `crux serve` as unreachable (#16721).
- Clarify gateway model reconciliation logs by distinguishing the old model from the selected gateway model.
- Preserve pack-owned gateway models when runtime model overrides are lost and the gateway has no default model.
- Workflow auto-approval now retries a PR head on the next sweep when the approve call fails transiently (5xx, network error, cancellation, or a rate-limit `403`) instead of silently spending the head's single approval pass, and no longer trusts this hive's App as triggering actor on fork heads, since a public App installed on a fork pushes with the same bot login ([#16739](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16739), [#16743](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16743)).
- Pack agents added at higher ACMM levels keep the hive's inference gateway and model after runtime overrides are lost ([#16740](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16740)).
- The `prow/lgtm` status warning comment is posted once per PR with its own live context instead of retrying on an expired one (#16753)
- Corrected the `bindProwLgtm` comment to describe returned reporting errors and best-effort warnings; runtime behavior is unchanged (#16761).
- Stage-label check digest no longer files a fleet self-report when GitHub answers the combined-status read with a 500 (#16778)
- Classify the issue-activity collector's REST reserve shedding ("github REST budget below reserve") as GitHub rate limiting so fleet reports no longer file it as a fetch failure; the local WARN logs and real fetch-failure reports are unchanged.
- Routine inference prose-only action nudges no longer trigger unclassified runtime-error self-reports; local warning logs and nudge counters remain unchanged.
- ACMM pack agents (such as strategist) now get their per-agent user, private group and pre-created token cache when the level comes from the config's `acmm_level` or the persisted hive state, not only from `HIVE_LEVEL`, so they no longer fall back to the shared full-privilege token ([#16803](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16803)).
- The dashboard no longer shows an obsolete superseded-upgrade notice after a later roll; it shows the running commit and its age instead.
- A tooling-failure blocked verdict now releases the `blocked` label only when the hive applied it; a human-applied `blocked` label is left in place ([#16841](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16841)).
- The self-report feed no longer files a GitHub 5xx on the review-request watcher's review POST (retried with backoff by design) as an unclassified repeated error; 4xx and non-5xx failures stay reportable (#16844).
- The in-app `capability-gap` glossary (decision glossary and tracker filter popover) now carries the same rule as the operator doc: a claim that workflow files cannot be pushed is not a gap when the hive checked that it can push them in that repository.
- The ntfy rate-limit cooldown now caps a server-sent `Retry-After` at the same one-hour ceiling the fallback backoff already uses. Before, a single 429 carrying a large value (a day, a year) set a deadline the cooldown logic never shortens, so ntfy notifications were silently dropped until the process restarted; the default server is the public ntfy.sh, so that value was not under the operator's control (#16871).
- `crux.frontmatter.Split` now recognises front matter blocks in files that start with a UTF-8 byte-order mark (BOM), fixing silent loss of `skills:` metadata in AGENTS.md and skill files written by Windows Notepad or PowerShell (#16878)
- Stabilize inception question categories and IDs for list labels containing multiple category keywords by preferring the longest match and breaking ties lexicographically ([#16882](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16882)).
- The documentation for disabled `/mcp/knowledge` now correctly describes the response codes: anonymous callers receive 401, and authenticated callers receive 404 ([#16916](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16916)).
- A hive without `project.org` no longer reports its repos as `/name` in the dashboard status ([#16917](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16917)).
- Defensive guard: the dashboard PR-queue repo check and kick-message repo list no longer join `org + "/" + repo` when `project.org` is empty, so they cannot emit `/repo`. Such a config is still rejected by the validator at startup; the guard only hardens the two remaining join sites ([#16923](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16923)).
- `native-queue-policy` no longer spends its ~22-minute evidence wait on label flips it never reads (`size/*`, `dco-signoff`, `hive/claimed-by-*`, `copilot`, stage labels); instead it replays the latest successful `native-queue-policy` run on the same head rather than fabricating a pass, still applies the live hold/draft/head-move check, and falls through to the full exact-head evidence wait when there is no prior success to replay (the head was never evaluated, or the last wait failed or timed out) or GitHub returns a 5xx, so a stale red verdict is never pinned onto later cosmetic flips. Flips of `hold`, `needs-human`, `release-in-progress` and `do-not-merge` always run the full wait ([#16945](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16945)).
- A self-report relayed through the hub now joins an open `hive/selfreport` issue of the same keyworded class instead of filing a new one when its message differs from the existing issue's, matching what spokes posting directly already did; an operator now gets one issue per class per defect rather than one per message, as when one spoke's `ioscan_classifier_unavailable` produced two issues five minutes apart; classes without keywords still never join by class alone ([#16954](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16954), [#16955](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16955)).
- The push broker's outgoing-diff gate now consults every exact-shape credential pattern `logscrub` knows — the hive canary marker, GitHub tokens, JWTs, AWS access keys, Slack and Discord webhook URLs, Slack tokens and private-key blocks — through the new `logscrub.FindSecret`, instead of only the GitHub-token/JWT `TokenPattern`. A committed AWS key, private key or planted canary used to be brokered and published; it is now refused, and the error names the category (`contains a private-key-shaped secret`) without echoing the value. The heuristic shapes `ScrubString` masks in logs (`sk-…` keys, `Bearer …`, `Basic …`) stay out of the gate because they match fixtures and documentation too readily to block a push on (#16966).
- fix(dashboard): merged-ledger test is deterministic across the UTC midnight boundary (#16972)
- Automerge stage reconciler: prevent stage oscillation on PRs parked at `stage/085-needs-decision` by preserving 085 against pending check-runs re-triggered on the same head without a human decision or new push, and add a per-(repo, number, head) transition dampener in `stagelabels.Store` that caps rapid transitions between two stages within 30 minutes ([#16974](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/16974)).
- Agent panes that show hive's own login-pattern source or grep output (for example `file.go:NN: "Please run /login"`) are no longer misread as a login screen, so reviewers that read loginscan/watchdog code stop raising a false "needs login" banner; the watchdog also only checks the bottom of the pane for login prompts ([#17006](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/17006)).
- Dashboard GitHub login requests **no** OAuth scope again — #11051 had switched the device flow to `public_repo`, which pushed every viewer through GitHub's "read and write repository data" consent page just to look at a hive. Dashboard feedback no longer files the issue with any hive-held credential: the hive stores the diagnostic bundle on a `hive-feedback` branch using its GitHub App installation token and opens a prefilled `issues/new` page (summary ≤ 6 KB plus a link to the bundle) that the user submits as themselves. Operator PATs still never author feedback. A source-level guard test keeps the login path scope-free ([#1927](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/1927)).
- Fix chat and Discord reconnect backoff and cancellation handling.
- Fix task-scoped MCP scope resolution for hub-launched agents by adding active launch lookup, per-launch URL scope parameters, and a short prompt pointer to `context_bundle`.
- Task-MCP lease tokens for staged runs now carry their mint-time stage and are refused with `stage_mismatch` after the run advances to another stage.
- Removed the wall-clock ceilings from the Slack and Telegram reconnect backoff reset tests by routing the Listen delay through the injectable sleeper and asserting the exact computed delays (#8336)
- Hold v6 Spektacular plan leases at the plan checkpoint until the imported plan is approved, so `/api/runs` exposes the gated plan before implement.
- Reconcile closed donated standby PRs so two closed-unmerged donations suspend that contributor configuration.
- Allow local v6 standby runbook harnesses to redirect the mutation convergence journal away from /data.
- Keep standby contributor relays passive after standby task completion instead of requesting ordinary work.
- Publish the dashboard status snapshot before potentially blocking agent kick delivery so S8 auto dispatch can run on suppressed lanes.
- Applying an ACMM pack now persists reconciled pack-owned agent fields into per-agent overlays, so config reloads keep the selected level while preserving operator-owned model/backend/pause/effort choices ([#8938](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/8938)).
- Fix dashboard section expansion so tall Repositories, Beads, and Agents content is no longer clipped by a fixed max-height cap.
- Fixed dashboard repo-card issue and PR pills so columns do not overlap, single-sided cards use the full pill width, and pill titles ellipsize while keeping #N visible.
- Dashboard: removed the duplicated Advisory, ACMM Eval, Tokens, and Cost sidebar items that the v5→v6 forward-merge left rendered twice in the Dashboard nav group; a regression test now asserts every sidebar `data-section` target appears only once in `index.html` (#9111).
- v6 chat suppresses recently seen inbound message IDs, and Slack Socket Mode keeps acknowledging messages and answering pings while commands run in order on a bounded delivery queue, preventing slow commands from causing duplicate execution on redelivery ([#9123](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/9123)).
- The chat bot now announces a run that is already waiting on a human approval the first time it sees it — including right after a restart — instead of silently treating it as the diff baseline ([#9124](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/9124)). A bare `approve`/`reject` sent when no checkpoint is tracked for the author now gets an explicit-form hint (`!runs approve <key>` / `!runs reject <key> <reason>`) instead of no reply at all.
- Attribute token-authenticated chat actions, including kicks, checkpoint decisions, and inception, to the chat transport and author instead of `local` ([#9125](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/9125)).
- The chat SSE notification bridge now gives up after 30 s on a dashboard that accepts the `/api/events` connection but never sends response headers, and reconnects, instead of waiting out the 10-minute idle watchdog ([#9126](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/9126)).
- Chat replies and notifications longer than the transport's message limit are now split by the shared chat spine before they reach a backend, and rate-limited sends are retried instead of dropped ([#9127](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/9127)). Previously a Discord reply over 2,000 characters — a `!runs` listing with a few dozen runs was enough — was posted whole, rejected with HTTP 400 and silently lost, while a Slack `429` slept the uninterruptible `Retry-After` on the drain goroutine and then discarded the message anyway. `drainLoop` now cuts every queued message to the backend's configured limit (line boundaries, code fences closed and reopened across chunks); Discord and Slack return a typed `chat.RetryableError` on `429` (Discord also parses `retry_after` on message polls) and on 5xx, and the spine waits the capped, context-aware `Retry-After` before re-sending the same chunk, up to three attempts, so shutdown is never blocked on a rate-limit sleep.
- Outbound chat messages no longer let untrusted text (issue titles, agent summaries) trigger mentions: the Slack chat bot escapes mrkdwn control characters (`&`, `<`, `>`) outside code spans so `<!channel>`/`<!here>`/`<@U…>` render literally, and only turns markdown links into Slack links for HTTP(S) URLs; Discord bot messages and Discord notification webhooks disable mention parsing (`allowed_mentions`) so `@everyone` and role/user mentions no longer ping the channel, and Discord bot messages now suppress link embeds as the webhook already did ([#9128](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/9128)).
- The shared chat spine no longer presents itself as a Discord bot on every transport ([#9129](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/9129)). The online banner and `!help` header now name the backend actually in use (`Hive chat bot online (slack)`), and spine log lines are prefixed `chat:` with a `backend=` attribute instead of `discord:`. Dashboard errors echoed by `!kick`/`!pause`/`!resume` are now bounded to the first line of the response body, capped at 200 bytes with control characters stripped, so an HTML error page or stack trace no longer lands verbatim in the channel. The Slack backend no longer logs `slack socket disconnected … use of closed network connection` on every clean shutdown.
- Persona learning now counts the `skipped` signal when an owner answers a run checkpoint prompt with a plain `approve`/`reject` reply, not only via `!runs approve`/`!runs reject`; the plain reply carried no command author, so the documented primary decision path never produced evidence. The per-author "summary shown"/"expanded" marks a run accumulates are also dropped for every author once the run leaves its human gate or finishes, instead of living for the process lifetime ([#9130](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/9130)).
- Chat commands, pending inception answers and run checkpoint replies now match `allowed_users` entries the way dashboard sign-in does (case-insensitive, `github:` prefix optional), so a hub-delivered `github:alice:owner` entry authorizes dashboard chat commands from `alice` (#9131).
- Fixed dashboard chat `!` commands on token and open spokes by forwarding the authenticated dashboard role to the shared chat spine.
- Dashboard chat now refreshes its command allowlist from heartbeat configuration updates, so added and removed users take effect without restarting the chat service. Concurrent chat handlers read the allowlist safely during refresh ([#9132](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/9132)).
- Dashboard chat now sends `!runs spec <owner/repo#n>` to the chat command spine so it starts a spec run instead of returning the active-run listing ([#9133](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/9133)).
