On the hive's own PR the App no longer tries to review itself (GitHub 422 "Can not approve your own pull request"): the queue note is a comment, the operator's approval is recorded in the hive's store as the plain Approve records it, and the self-authored lane merges on it; the review-request watcher downgrades such a refused review to a COMMENT instead of retrying.
- logscrub: `ScrubString` and the contributor relay now mask the same api-key, Slack/Discord webhook, Slack token and Basic-auth shapes on v5 as on v6 ([#16470](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/pull/16470)).
- Activity Monitor: the "Merged" ledger pill now rolls its numbers like a mileage odometer when they rise (per digit, ≈0.9 s ease-out; the total and the today / this week figures alike), sets them outright on the first draw, on a fall such as the midnight reset or under reduced motion, and keeps its width while rolling; the merge glyph's flight slowed from 0.9 s to 2 s on an ease-out, with the merged row pinned 3.5 s so it outlasts the landing.
- The dashboard's 🙋 Needs human facet now matches by pattern (`needs-human*`, `*needs-decision`, `*needs-author`) as well as by name, so new stages and labels no longer silently fall out of it; the *All labels* dialog shows a "Needs human covers N labels" group listing exactly which labels the facet selects. ([#13780](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13780))
- Make the `/ok-to-test` workflow template (and `hivectl ok-to-test-template`, now with `--app-login` defaulting to the hive's App login) fully self-contained with the approval logic inlined — no `uses: hivecommons/hive/...` reference — so it works under restrictive Actions policies and on GHES; the 085 stage entry now embeds that rendered workflow when held runs outlive the `/ok-to-test` grace.
- Contributor-lane auto-merge: a hive owner / trusted merger's explicit approval on the current head — a GitHub `APPROVED` review on that commit, or a dashboard `/hive decision approve` bound to it — now releases the `contributor-lane:workflow-path` fence, so the hive merges an approved PR editing `.github/workflows/**` / `.github/actions/**` itself instead of parking it at `stage/090-ready-for-human-merge` (`auto_merge.contributor_lane.owner_approval_releases_workflow_fence`, default on). Approval on an older head does not count; a merge refused for want of the App's `workflows: write` marks the PR `hive:unauthorized` (`merge-workflow-path`) and parks the approved head at 090 as before. The 085 note for an unapproved workflow-path PR now reads "awaiting owner approval" (#14664).
- Hive activity monitor: `sentinel`, `needs human`, `needs human decision` and merge-time `unauthorized` pills are held back (payload `deferred_modifiers`) until the pull request reaches the merge gate (stage/080+), and do not count under *Needs attention* before then; `hold`, `draft`, `stalled`, `regressed` and an `unauthorized` on held workflow runs always show.
- Activity Monitor: a lit "PR in progress" chevron names who works the PR with their kind icon — `PR in progress · @login` plus the hive / clanker / person glyph, the way "Waiting for @login" does (hivecommons/hive#16770); the name truncates with the copy, the tooltip holds the full text, and nobody known keeps the bare word.
- Refreshed the model list-price table from OpenRouter (29 rows moved; list prices as of 2026-10-22): GPT-5.2/5.4/5.4-mini/5.5, the GPT-5.6 sol/terra/luna codex variants and GPT-5.3-codex now carry OpenAI's current per-family rates instead of a flat $1.25/$10; Claude Opus 4.1 ($15/$75), Sonnet 5 ($2/$10) and the Fable 5.1 / Sonnet 5.5 cache-read rates follow Anthropic's published figures; Gemini 2.5/3.5/3.6/3.7 Flash, Grok 4.5, Kimi K3 / K2.7-code, Llama 3.3 70B and DeepSeek chat follow their providers' current list prices. The Cost panel estimate uses the new rates from this release on.
- Refreshed the model list-price table from OpenRouter (2 rows moved; list prices as of 2026-10-26); the Cost panel estimate now uses the new rates.
- Refreshed the Kimi K3 and K2.7 Code list-price estimates from Kimi's direct API pricing as of 2026-11-02, using K3's default 5-minute cache-write rate; all other model rates remain unchanged.
- **Prior-art gate searches docs and code locally across every registered repo** — the `docs` and `code` prior-art sources now query a `pkg/codeindex` snapshot of each `project.repos` checkout under `checkouts_dir` instead of GitHub code search, so findings cover all repos without spending the code-search quota, and a missing, dirty or partly indexed checkout is called out in the gate comment when a comment is posted ("checkout missing/partial for <repo>", repo slug only, no host paths), and recorded in the audit log (`prior-art-gate-coverage-gap`) otherwise, rather than read as no prior art; coverage is as of the local checkout, not origin (#13878). Reports built while the index is still building are not cached, and the first index build starts at startup.
- Issues filed through `hive-open-issue` now follow the prior-art filing verdict: a high-confidence match is refused (naming the existing item) and recorded as a knowledge bead, and a medium match must carry a "Gap vs existing" section and gets the findings attached; each refusal is audited as `agent_issue_prior_art_refused`; off with `runs.triage.prior_art.enabled: false` ([#13879](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13879)).
- Show the dashboard shell before downloading its cacheable application script, prioritize the selected and visible panels, limit background refresh concurrency, and progressively render the latest live data without waiting for every panel before restoring navigation.
- Activity Monitor: every PR whose only remaining step is the merge itself now reads one chevron word, **Queued for merge**, with a short qualifier after the dot saying why it has not merged yet — *· next pass in 42s*, *· checking now*, *· soak 12m left*, *· 2nd of 3* (merge train), *· next pass* (Approve / Let hive decide), *· after CI* (Approve and let hive merge while checks run, or a merge call refused for unreported checks), *· needs rebase* (head moved under the merge call), *· branch protection pending*. Three adjacent approved rows on hive's own tracker read *Ready for auto merge …*, *Approved · hive will…* and *Approved · merge queu…*; the tooltip keeps the full explanation. *Soaking*, *Merging*, *Rebasing*, *Needs human decision* and a *Merge failed* a person must fix stay their own words (hivecommons/hive#16653).
- `hivectl evidence benchmark` now also draws the README outcome cards as 2× PNGs with an embedded font (flat colours, no glow), gains `--from-json` to re-render committed assets without the evidence tree, and the README embeds the PNGs so the cards look the same in every browser.
- The README and its outcome cards are written as short full sentences in plain speech, with the numbers inside the sentences. A test now rejects semicolons and label lines in the README prose and card text.
- README rewritten around plain-language evidence cards: `hivectl evidence benchmark` now also renders dark/light full-width SVG cards (accuracy, a before/after scenario from one real pull request, prompt injection, cost, "also" strip, how-it-works ladder) gated by `--readme-min-base` (default 200), takes `--stories` and `--red-team` inputs, and the generated README block lists Accuracy / Security / Cost / Also with no statistical vocabulary; the detailed charts and intervals stay in `src/docs/benchmarks/`, and the former README overview moved to `src/docs/what-is-hive.md`.
- Refresh the README around trust, productivity, efficiency, governance and auditability, with sourced charts and supported work tools. Benchmark regeneration no longer rewrites the root README; redraw its graphics with `node docs/readme/render-charts.mjs`.
- The review swarm now reviews **every open PR regardless of author** — hive agent, human, clanker at either trust tier, dependabot and any other bot — whenever PR review is on (`review.require_approval` + `review.fan_out`); the only switch is the review feature itself. `review.all_authors` is a deprecated no-op (still accepted, logged once). The automerge review gate now also covers the `trusted-bot` and `trusted-author` lanes, so a human's PR waits for the swarm verdict the same way the App's own does; previously human PRs merged through the trusted-author tier with zero swarm reviews ([#12974](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/12974)).
- A reviewer's scope / follow-up question on a hive-authored PR with CI green and no unresolved finding no longer parks the PR at 085 "Needs human decision": the dashboard classifies the ask and runs the existing *Let hive decide* pipeline itself (approve → merge queue plus a `follow-up:` issue; direction → fixer; owner-only → park with the recommendation), once per head, while policy sign-off asks (workflow edits from forks, OWNERS / secrets / permissions, auto-merge config, sentinel) stay a person's. Off switch `governor.review.auto_decide_questions`; counter `review_questions_autodecided_1h` on `/api/status`.
- The RFC notice poll now remembers pull requests found not to be RFCs by head SHA, so unrelated busy PRs no longer have their files listed on every poll ([#15960](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15960)).
- Security docs rot pass: stale "tracked in" citations to closed issues (#2804, #6685, #9586) now say what landed or point at the live successor, every page in the set carries a `Last reviewed:` date, and a new CI guard `src/scripts/check-security-docs-rot.sh` (in the Docs Link Check workflow) fails when that date is older than 120 days or a tracking sentence cites a closed issue.
- The security documentation set (`security-model.md`, `security-threat-model.md`, `security-response.md`, `securing-your-hive.md`, `ioscan.md`, `ioscan-red-team.md`, `security-self-assessment.md`) is rewritten in plain language for a non-expert reader: 60% shorter overall, every page at Flesch-Kincaid grade 11 or below, process notes and `path:line` citations dropped, and factual drift fixed (responder roster, escalation path, SBOM statement, stale v4 header). A new CI guard, `src/scripts/check-security-docs-readability.sh`, runs in the Docs Link Check workflow and fails any of these pages, or `SECURITY.md`, that drifts above grade 11.
- Self-authored (Hive-authored) PR decision questions now escalate to `stage/085-needs-decision` only when they match a named risk class (`review.DecisionRiskClasses`: permissions/credentials, security, sensitive paths, data loss/irreversible, merge/trust policy, external side effects, licensing/legal, unverifiable) or the reviewer marks `<!-- hive-decision-risk: high -->`; every other question is resolved by policy and recorded as an advisory reason, replacing the narrow non-risk allowlist that parked green agent PRs (#13020) whose linked issue had already answered the question. The reviewer template now tells the swarm to cite the linked issue/spec (`per #<issue>: …`) instead of re-asking.
- The dashboard sidebar now reads "Experiment Lab (nous)" and "Inception (spektacular)" so the engine behind each section is visible from the left menu; the section card titles follow the same wording.
- `hive:signoff-attribution` and `hive:unauthorized` notes are now one comment per PR (per blocked step for `unauthorized`), edited in place with a capped update history / attempt count when a new head hits the same block, instead of a fresh copy per push (hivecommons/hive#17066).
- The stage engine now treats a covering PR closing (040→010/030/020) and claim/start-marker reshuffles (030→020) as expected issue transitions instead of anomalies.
- Stage labels now flow through a single `StageWriter` (`pkg/github/stage_writer.go`): the automerge `ApplyStageLabels` sweep and the issue `SyncIssueStageLabels` sweep build `stageengine.Facts` and reconcile through `stageengine.Reconciler.ReconcileBatch` (default shadow mode, byte-identical labels). An AST admission test forbids direct `stage/*` add/remove calls outside the writer, with a temporary allow-list for the relay/claim/ledger paths. Part of #12999.
- Out-of-cycle stage writers (claim relay and release, in-progress start mark, PR-claim sync, decision parking and `/hive approve`/`/hive decision` un-park, dashboard contributor claims and verdict settle) now submit facts to the central stage engine (`stageengine.FactSink`) instead of writing `stage/*` labels directly; the resulting labels are unchanged, and a lapsed claim, lifted park or closed PR re-stages the issue immediately rather than a cycle later ([#13009](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13009), part of [#12999](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/12999)).
- Hive activity monitor: rows order attention-first within each column — rows a person must act on now (a shown pill or a human-gated stage) first, plain rows next, `hold` / `draft` / closed-issue-anchored rows last — for the *Furthest along* and *Longest waiting* sorts and for the PR sub-rows under an issue; the direction arrow flips the age order but never the tier, and the `GET /api/stage-tracker` payload is pre-sorted the same way so chat `/prs` and the hub agree.
- Hive activity monitor: hover text in a tracker row now appears only on the `#N` link (which carries the row tooltip), the covering-PR link, the title and the lit chevron (stage plus whose move it is); passed and upcoming chevrons, the kind, author and mover icons, chips and the `since` column no longer show tooltips.
- Stage Tracker: soaking rows now say what the reader cares about — **Soaking · 4m left**, **Soaking · complete** once the window has run out, **Mergeable · merging now** when the lane's pass is on the soaked head — instead of the lane's internal "merge sweep" name, and the 095 caption ages the soak clock from the lane's last read instead of pinning "0s left at the last sweep" on a row still called soaking. (hivecommons/hive#15575)
- Hive activity monitor: every movement animation now runs flash → move → land — the chevron an item is leaving pulses twice before the chosen effect travels and the new chevron lands lit (one soft flash then a crossfade under `prefers-reduced-motion`); flash timing is tokenised as `--ham-move-flash-*`.
- Activity Monitor: a PR nested under its issue now draws its header on one line — connector, author icon, number, title, lineage chip and base-branch pill side by side with the title ellipsizing (full title on hover) — instead of stacking the connector, the title and the pill on three lines; issue titles and the top-level PR header ellipsize the same way.
- Activity Monitor merge zap re-voiced as a real bug-zapper arc: a high-voltage snap followed by a sputtering 120 Hz mains sizzle that dies out over ~0.45 s, high-passed at 700 Hz, replacing the swept-bandpass crackle and thunk.
- The Activity Monitor's "waiting on" chip now draws who a row waits on instead of spelling it out: a human owner reads `waiting on [person] @login` with the stage chevrons' person glyph and no "(human · no clanker)" qualifier; a contributor's hive reads `waiting on [robot ●] @login` with the clanker's robot head and the online / offline / unknown dot beside it. The hover title says the rest — `Waiting on @zoe (human) — waiting for a human reply` / `Waiting on @hanthor's hive (clanker · offline 26h) — hive will adopt at …` ([#15227](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15227)).
- Getting Started checklist: plain-language "what Hive is" intro matching the docs, current method list (codex, goose, agy, omp, bob; openrouter, watsonx gateways), ACMM spelled out, Inception and Experiment Lab added to "More to explore", and docs links moved from the legacy docs.kubestellar.io domain and the v4 branch to docs.hivecommons.dev / v5.
- Adoption close-first now asks the write-back gate before it closes, labels or reopens a contributor's original PR ([#15272](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/15272)). These writes land on a PR the hive did not author, but they were only counted in the direct-write ratchet baseline, so they ignored a repo pause, the per-repo mode and the `contributor_adopt` kind policy (default L6 + opt-in label). When the gate refuses, the original stays open and closes when the hive's copy merges, and the refusal shows up in the write-back drill-down. A reopen that is due waits for the next poll, for example until an operator lifts a pause; a refusal for any other reason (the kind policy changed after the hive closed the PR) is logged at warn, because it leaves a hive-closed PR shut until a person reopens it. The ratchet baseline drops `automerge_adoption_close_first.go` (7 → 0).

### Fixed

- Failed pane writes and rejected kick deliveries now reach the governor and kick-status error paths without recording success; repeated write failures use the existing undeliverable reporting, a failed insurance Enter after the first was accepted still counts as delivered, and idle reviewer lanes and first-scan-deferred targets appear as skipped in governor evaluation logs ([#12846](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/12846)).
- The `hive-action-smoke` workflow is now registered on the default branch so it can be dispatched, and its relay comment @-mentions a configurable `app_handle` (default `hivecommons-hive`) that the hive's mention parser recognises (#12964).
- With `agent_issue_decision_policy: resolve`, Hive-authored needs-decision requests are now downgraded only when they positively classify as engineering questions; requests the classifier cannot place stay parked for the owner (#12969, #12972)
- Fix the governor run loop stalling during a GitHub rate-limit caution window: the issue stage-label sync is now deadline-bounded and legacy label housekeeping is deferred until the window lapses, so config reloads and heartbeat stats no longer starve.
- Saving an agent's prompt template from the dashboard no longer fails with "permission denied" when the shipped template in `/data/policies` is read-only (e.g. on hosted hives). The edit is saved as a user override in `/data/policy-overrides`, which the editor and the next agent run read ahead of the shipped default; the editor now flags a read-only shipped template and shows where the override is saved (#13005).
- Claim label is generic hive/claimed-by-human, not per-user (#13051)
- Pull requests are never claimed as issues: review-swarm review/fix kicks (whose refs are PRs) are no longer listed in the issue-claims ledger, and the claim admission gate refuses a number that names a pull request. A PR author's comment on its own PR no longer records an issue claim that staged the PR `stage/030-pr-in-progress` — an issue-only stage — until the PR sweep healed it (hivecommons/hive#13061, seen on #12994).
- The issue relay no longer reports `ok:true` for a `stage/045-needs-decision` (or `needs-human`) park the stage engine did not apply: if the issue still wears another stage afterwards, the result is `ok:false` with the reason and the request is retried (#13069).
- Owner advice no longer counts on-demand agents (those with no schedule by design) as missing a cadence; only agents that should have a cadence but don't are flagged ([#13083](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13083)).
- Hive now acknowledges `/hive approve` on pull requests once per command and explains what the merge lane will and will not do with it — naming the GitHub **Approve** review that releases a `requires_human` hold — without clearing hold labels. The `stage/085-needs-decision` comment names the lane's release action, including when a maintainer must merge manually ([#13087](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13087)).
- Review-backlog findings whose evidence file exists only on the reviewed PR (absent on its base branch) are filed `blocked` with a `<!-- hive:blocked-on pr=owner/repo#N -->` marker and without `help wanted`; a `blocked` issue derives no stage label and refuses every automated claim, and a sweep lifts the label once the PR merges or closes. `hive-open-issue comment --blocked-on-pr <n>` posts the same neutral note with `@`-mentions stripped, so the scanner no longer pings a fork's author to do the hive's work. The contributor relay keeps a session off an issue it just failed or abandoned for `governor.claims.reclaim_cooldown_s` (default 6h) instead of handing it back every ten minutes.
- Exclude stall nudges that the harness "continue" nudge recovered from the fleet-report `agent stall` evidence so self-recovery no longer files hive defects (#13098).
- The release comments the hub posts when it lifts a relay-applied `blocked` or decision label now treat the relay-supplied verdict reason as untrusted text (#13106): it is flattened onto one line, capped on a rune boundary, stripped of HTML comment delimiters so it cannot forge the hub's own idempotency markers, and @mentions in it are neutralised, so a contributor relay can no longer make the App identity notify arbitrary users or inject extra lines into an issue comment. The verified reporter handle still reads as a mention.
- Preserve UTF-8 rune boundaries when truncating contributor verdict reasons in the persisted ledger, preventing replacement characters in long multilingual reasons ([#13110](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13110)).
- Show superseded contributor PRs with close / keep-open actions in the Review Queue even when automatic closure is disabled; the sweep audits every detection and the queue shows no countdown while `supersession_sweep.close_contributor_prs` is off ([#13114](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13114)).
- Fixed a `requires_human` verdict on an untrusted contributor PR routing to `stage/050-review-pending` (and picking up `stage/stalled`) instead of `stage/085-needs-decision` when the contributor lane's author-association admission reason applied or nothing had reported on the head yet (#13115, #13112).
- Superseded contributor PR threads now lead with the close/keep-open decision: review comments render the `hive-decision-question` as visible text, reviews marked `<!-- hive-redundant-of: #N -->` (now documented in the reviewer policy) show a `no-op merge: duplicate of #N` headline instead of a 0/5 score, and the supersession sweep notice addresses the repo operator with the recommendation and choices, staying neutral when an operator already chose keep-open (#13116).
- The entrypoint's agent token-cache re-own step now matches only the agent's own `gh-token-<agent>.cache` files (and `.cache.*` / `-<n>.cache` siblings) instead of any file containing the agent name, so `reviewer` no longer steals `code-reviewer`'s token cache ([#13123](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13123)).
- The review-fix kick no longer pushes hive-signed commits onto PRs whose login author is a person, even when the PR is hive-attributed; the fix is proposed in the review instead (#13124).
- The dashboard now shows the release semver the hive is running ([#13130](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13130)). `/api/version` returned only a hard-coded legacy `version` constant and the commit, so the build-stamped semver (`hive --version`, already sent to the hub) never reached the UI. It now exposes it as `release` (omitted when the build has no version), and the sidebar version chip and menu show it next to the commit.
- The dashboard header's feedback, theme and other right-hand buttons no longer overlap the project title or ACMM badge at window widths between 769px and 900px; those widths now show icon-only Settings, Health and Guide chips ([#13135](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13135)).
- 085 entry comment follows the decision cause; flag @maintainer placeholder questions (#13139)
- Moves within 070/071/072 re-attribute the fix, not a regression (#13140)
- Contributor dispatch now honors `[vN]` title prefixes and `Target: vN` issue-body declarations, while a validated `wrong_base` verdict re-routes the next offer instead of applying `hive/already-done` or closing the issue ([#13146](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13146)).
- A `replicas:` copy of an agent (`<agent>-2` .. `<agent>-N`) can now read its own GitHub token on per-UID deployments ([#13166](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13166)). Replicas exist only in memory, so the entrypoint never gave them a `hive-<agent>-N` user, private token group or pre-created token cache. The manager ran each replica as a bare `uid:node` and its cache was written `dev:node 0600`, so every `gh` call in the replica was blocked with `token_cache_unavailable` and a restart did not help. The entrypoint now derives replica names from each agent's `replicas:` setting and provisions them at boot like declared agents. Raising `replicas` on a running hive still needs a restart before the new copies can read their tokens.
- Fixed: a not-licensed Copilot 403 during model discovery is no longer filed as a fleet `model_discovery_degraded` self-report; it is only warned and audited locally. (#13206)
- The superseded "Close now" action now refuses (404) a pull request with no recorded supersession state instead of closing it with a generic comment ([#13224](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13224)).
- `just contribute-check` / `contribute-setup` / `contribute-move` now derive their accepted backend list from `KNOWN_BACKENDS` in `config/backends.conf` instead of a hard-coded copy, so the Justfile gate and the launcher can no longer disagree: `aider` (wired through backends.conf, the relay and the local launch path) is accepted with its own preflight probe, and `gemini` (no CLI in the contributor image and no `backend_binary` mapping) is no longer accepted by the gate. `bin/test_backend_smoke.sh` gains a parity check. Closes #13262, #13263.
- CI's base-image registry probe now verifies every linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 layer blob on mirror.gcr.io, not just the manifest list, and falls back to docker.io when a layer is missing — the pull-through mirror intermittently 404s a layer behind a manifest it still serves, which failed Docker builds across PRs with "could not fetch content descriptor ... not found". (#13300)
- The issue stage sweep now writes `stage/040-covered-by-pr` when GitHub actually lacks it: the in-memory covered-by-PR label the claim guard adds for the dashboard no longer hides the missing forge label from the planner, so an issue whose 040 was stripped by a claim release (or never written at PR open) is re-staged next cycle instead of staying stage-less while its PR is open ([#13316](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13316)).
- fix(agent): credit stall recovery when a new kick or provider disarm resets the nudge, so fleet reports stop flagging uncredited recoveries as agent stalls (#13333, #13335)
- fix(stage): copy issue labels before synthesising stage/040 so callers are not aliased (#13336)
- Hive auto-merge (trusted-author, contributor, self-authored and queued lanes) and the hive-merge relay no longer squash forward-merge / top-up PRs: a `🌱 top-up:` or `sync:` title, a `topup/*` or `sync/v*-to-v*` head, or a head that merges another release branch now always lands as a merge commit, preserving the release lines' merge-base ([#13404](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13404)).
- Activity monitor: sidelined PRs (drafts, exempt labels) now carry GitHub's closing references too, so a draft with a valid `Fixes #N` pairs with its issue instead of showing "no linked issue"; linked issues keep their title on both the batch and per-repo GraphQL paths.
- Webhook re-bucketed PRs keep their linked issues in the activity monitor instead of waiting for the next reconcile tick ([#13448](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13448)).
- The Cost card's headline total now uses the same estimator as the trend chart — persisted per-day totals for days the snapshot ring no longer holds plus the positive step-to-step increments inside the ring — instead of a sum of per-"lineage" peaks that double counted the residual surviving a partial reset (a counter falling 13,964 → 5,058 added the 5,058 again, ≈$6K over on one spoke), missed spend inside a lineage that dipped and regrew, and changed every time the ring evicted a sample (the "since" date crept from Aug 8 to Aug 10 within a day of viewing). Only a step that is both abnormally large and restores the counter to a level it had already reached is treated as a data correction; a large step to a new high is spend. The "since" date — and the window the merged-PR / closed-issue denominators are counted over (`count_window_start`) — now comes from the oldest per-day total and is stable, so the headline and the per-PR / per-issue tiles name the same window. Fixes [#13481](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13481).
- The Cost chart and per-day rollup no longer discard real spend revealed after a sampling gap. The discontinuity guard judged every increase of the cumulative estimate as if it had arrived at the 5-minute cadence, so when the collector had not sampled for hours or days (it only ran while a browser was polling) the single step that revealed that whole period was thrown away as a "correction" — on one spoke $10,679 of the $16,957 recorded increments, leaving a 14-day chart and run-rate that bore no relation to the headline. A step above the fixed ceiling is now kept when 20× the hive's average spend rate over the elapsed gap explains it (server `costFoldDailyRollups` and the UI's bucket code apply the same rule), and a step that is discarded now drops its token deltas too, so a day can no longer show 828M tokens at $0. Fixes [#13482](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13482).
- The cost history that feeds the Cost tab's sparkline, trend chart and run-rate is now sampled every 5 minutes by the hive itself instead of only when a browser polled `/api/knowledge/stats`. Spokes nobody was watching had multi-day holes (up to 296 h) that the chart drew as $0 and whose spend then landed as one step when the page was next opened. No snapshot is written before the token collector has reported anything, so startup cannot record a false $0 reset.
- The Cost card now says what its headline is in plain words — **Estimated spend at list price — since <date> · tokens × public per-token price · not a bill**, with a **?** tooltip explaining that subscription seats and self-hosted inference are not billed per token — instead of "estimated total (persisted history × list price)" beside an unexplained "$X current lineage". The live token summary is shown as "of which $X … since the last reset on <date>", the per-PR / per-issue tiles read "total ÷ N PRs merged by hive since <date> · counts as of <time>" with a note that both divide the same total and are not additive, stale GitHub counts carry their as-of time, the usage tables are tagged as live-summary-only, and token counts keep two significant digits at every magnitude (176K rather than "0.000B"). Fixes [#13484](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13484).
- The Cost chart, "spend in selected range" and run-rate no longer price historical models at $0. The per-model $/token map used to turn token increments into spend was taken from the newest snapshot alone; the token summary only lists the models of the sessions currently on disk, so once a hive's live traffic was down to a single helper model every Claude/GPT model in the history priced at $0 and the chart of a ~$17K history summed to $15 (flat sparkline, "run-rate ~$0.18/day" while the headline said $21K). Each model's rate is now taken from the newest snapshot that still lists that model. Fixes [#13498](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13498).
- Dashboard cost-recording staleness check now normalizes model ids the same way the token price table does (provider prefixes, dash collapsing, Bedrock and dated suffixes), removing false stale alarms for configured models ([#13503](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13503)).
- The reviewer lane's policy now carries the mandatory "do not wait for CI" guidance, so reviewer agents stop polling CI on PRs they have already handled instead of triggering the stop-polling nudge ([#13505](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13505)).
- The task-list sweep no longer puts `needs-human` back on an issue after a maintainer un-parked it with `/hive approve`, `/hive decision` or label approval; only a PR merged after that answer with its own `(needs-human: …)` marker re-adds the label ([#13516](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13516)).
- Resolve the GitHub App bot login without holding `selfLoginMu` across the network call, so `isHiveAccount` no longer blocks for up to 10s during the first lookup ([#13522](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13522)).
- Concurrent first-time lookups of the authenticated GitHub login now share one `GET /user` instead of each issuing their own; waiters receive the same result (or failure cooldown) and can cancel their own wait without aborting the lookup ([#13524](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13524)).
- Concurrent authenticated GitHub login lookups share one request and release pending waiters even if that request panics, allowing subsequent lookups to retry ([#13526](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13526)).
- `review.ReviewCapable` is now replica-aware (a replica of a listed `reviewer_agents` lane is review-capable) and is shared by dispatch, the dashboard, relay, merge-eligibility and reviewer accuracy; the PR author's base agent is resolved from the full configured agent set (enabled or not, including a replica a reduced `replicas:` count no longer materialises), so a base or sibling replica is never dispatched to review its own family's PR even when the authoring replica is paused, disabled or not review-capable, and the verdict relay's self-approval guard refuses a dispatch-less verdict from any lane in the author's family (#13552, #13562)
- Compliance evidence exports now include SHA-256 manifests, coverage and retention metadata, selected profile versions, attester identities, and the authenticated export or posture-run actor; each `compliance_export` audit entry records the SHA-256 of the delivered file ([#13582](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13582)).
- fix: `gh run watch` and `gh pr checks --watch` are now refused by the gh wrapper (reason=ci_watch_blocked) so agents cannot keep polling CI after the ci_poll_nudge; `watch` is dropped from the `run` surface allowlist (#13587, #13594, #13596)
- Sentinel now honours a maintainer's removal of `sentinel-alert` on a head it never alerted on: when the label was removed by a non-Hive human after the current head was pushed (a rebase between the alert and the review), the current head counts as cleared, the marker comment is rewritten for that head so the clearance survives a restart, and the label is not re-applied; a push after the removal still re-alerts. The push time is read only from signals GitHub stamps server-side — the `head_ref_force_pushed` event for the head, or the earliest check suite / commit status created for it — never from the commit's committer date, so a backdated commit cannot ride a stale clearance; a head with no such signal is re-alerted as before ([#13602](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13602)).
- The hold guard no longer re-holds a PR whose branch was rebased earlier during the hold when a human (not a Hive account or bot) removed the gate label after the current head arrived on the branch: that lift reviewed the current head, so the snapshot clears without the integrity comment or a fresh `hold`. The head is accepted only on evidence a contributor cannot forge: the server-stamped `head_ref_force_pushed` event that produced it, or the hive itself having observed that exact head on the PR while the gate was still on. Commit committer dates and SHA-keyed check-suite/status times are never used; a push after the lift, a head the hive never saw while held, a lift by the hive or a bot, or a failed lookup still re-holds as before ([#13603](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13603)).
- A review-backlog finding folded into an existing open issue over the same files now lands there in full — title, `file:line`, summary, severity, source PR and fingerprint — under an "Additional finding (folded in — same file, possibly a different problem)" heading with an unchecked task-list line, instead of a bare "Linked again from the Hive review of PR #N" comment; the `hive:review-backlog-link` dedup marker is unchanged, and the PR's backlog summary now reads `#T (folded into an existing issue) — <finding title>` instead of implying the twin carries that title ([#13604](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13604)).
- Label-driven approval no longer deadlocks on a lifecycle bot's park label: a repository can list automation accounts in `label_driven_supersede_park_actors` (project-wide or per repo) so that a trusted `triage/accepted` added after such a bot's `needs-human` removes it, says so in the release comment, and releases the issue; park labels added by people, by unlisted bots, or by a listed bot after the acceptance still block, `hold` is never superseded, and the list is empty by default ([#13605](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13605)).
- Queuing a PR for auto-merge with the default `lgtm` label now also sets the `prow/lgtm` commit status on the approved head commit, so repos running prow-github-actions v3 no longer strip the label and silently drop the PR from Hive's merge queue ([#13616](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13616)). If the status can't be written (the App needs `statuses: write`), Hive logs a warning and comments on the PR; other labels such as `hive/auto-merge` are unaffected.
- Spoke heartbeat: HTTP 502/503/504 from the hub front proxy (hub restarting / "no available server") are treated as transient and no longer self-reported as `unexpected_http_5xx_from_hub` (#13620).
- Reject `review_heads` agent names whose `hive-<name>` group exceeds 32 characters with an `alias` hint, and log `groupadd` failures in the entrypoint (#13622).
- Adoption no longer opens a `signoff-rehome` superseding PR that would carry the same head and fail the same sign-off gate; the adopted PR goes straight to `stage/085-needs-decision` with one note proposing a merge-commit (`--merge`, not squash) merge or a re-authored head.
- Stop role/trusted flapping on and off: keep the PR's existing role label when no lane reports an author tier in a pass (#13637)
- signoff: skip the sign-off attribution nudge and commit sign-off check on `sync/v*-to-v*` and top-up forward-merge heads, which carry other people's commits by design (#13635)
- config: reject review_heads names over the 32-char group limit (#13641)
- The CI-poll nudge no longer counts polling commands quoted as prohibitions in the kick prompt as the agent polling CI, which filed false `ci_poll_nudge` self-reports "0s after the kick" (#13648).
- Automerge no longer reports fork PRs that disallow maintainer edits as conflicting when update-branch is refused; they now skip as fork-not-editable, and an already-current branch is a no-op; same-repo 403s keep the plain update-branch error (#13650)
- Proxy client read timeouts and pre-handshake disconnects (including the transparent-proxy handshake and copilot-sniff client reads) no longer surface as repeated-error self-reports (#13652, #13657, #13661, #13665).
- Permissions watcher fixes now log at Info, and the interactive-home mode restore no longer warns on EPERM for homes the process does not own, avoiding repeated self-report issues Per-agent XDG dir creation and per-agent dir-mode restore likewise log at Debug on permission errors for unowned homes (#13653, #13654, #13655, #13662, #13663).
- Bound bead vault filenames (truncate + short hash) so long bead titles no longer fail ingest with ENAMETOOLONG (#13656).
- Stopped agents no longer flood WARN logs and self-report issues: `tmux has-session` failing because the per-UID tmux server is not running is now treated as "no session" rather than a probe failure (#13658).
- The copilot CLI model-substitution warning is logged once per agent session instead of on every poll, so it no longer surfaces as a repeated-error self-report (#13659).
- Workspace cleanup no longer sweeps dot-prefixed per-agent cache dirs (e.g. `.gomodcache-*`) and logs repeated permission-denied removal failures at Debug after the first Warn, stopping the repeated warning spam (#13660).
- Review-evidence bundle writes that fail with permission denied now warn once per path instead of repeating every poll; the evidence directory ownership still needs fixing on affected hosts (#13664).
- A missing GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET is warned about once per process instead of on every rejected webhook, so it no longer surfaces as a repeated-error self-report (#13666).
- GitHub REST negative-cache hits no longer log at Warn, so suppressed 404 refetches stop surfacing as repeated-error self-reports (#13667).
- Fleet self-report upstream-write and cleared-comment failures now warn once per fingerprint and error (Debug on repeats, re-armed after a successful write) instead of on every retry, so an unreachable report repo no longer files repeated-error self-reports ([#13675](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13675), [#13676](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13676)).
- Review-pending expiry and human-decision-label failures are logged once per PR (then at debug) instead of every sweep cycle, so they no longer surface as repeated-error self-reports (#13677, #13687).
- agent: stop re-fixing the antigravity CLI log mode on every permissions tick — the permissions watcher no longer re-chmods the Antigravity CLI log (`cli-*.log`) to group-write on every tick, which flooded the log with repeated mode fixes (#13692, #13653, #13695)
- The advisory digest no longer logs a `WARN advisory: issue state lookup failed` on every sweep for a referenced issue that was deleted (HTTP 410). `IssueClosedAt` now treats 410 like 404 — a terminal "not found, not closed" answer rather than an error — so the finding stays open without repeated warnings (#13725).
- The selfreport slog feed no longer files `unclassified_error_repeated` issues for the expected, self-healing "continuous re-kick backed off after failed kick" warning (for example a backend CLI slow to reach its input prompt); it is now recognised by the `kick_failed_repeatedly` class keywords, which only reports after the restart recovery fails ([#13732](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13732)).
- The selfreport slog feed treats the permissions watcher's `fixed …` lines (file/directory permissions, ownership) as benign self-healing and no longer files `unclassified_error_repeated` issues for them. On v5 the `fixed file permissions` line is already Info-level and never reached the feed, so this is a guard against re-promotion there; the `fixed ownership` line still logs at Warn and is now suppressed too ([#13735](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13735)).
- Refs-only PR claims now stage their issues as covered instead of actionable; activity rows show refs coverage, the covering PR's base branch, and tracker sub-issue progress when available, while preserving non-closing references for unchecked delegated tasks and watcher-downgraded links ([#13747](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13747)).
- Bound `/api/knowledge` responses with default pagination and add Previous/Next navigation to the dashboard Knowledge fact list, rendering at most 50 facts per page; expose `hivectl knowledge list --limit/--offset` so CLI users can retrieve subsequent pages (#13790).
- Collapsed dashboard sections skip rendering hidden content while preserving visible summaries, expand animations, and sparkline replay ([#13791](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13791)).
- Review dispatch no longer stacks several review kicks on one agent ([#13793](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13793)). With `review_heads` replicas, the replica picker counted distinct PR heads per agent, so replicas holding the same PR tied and one PR's remaining perspectives all went to the first replica. On a two-replica Sonnet head, four kicks reached one Claude session within three minutes; it ran one turn, the other verdicts never arrived, and they expired and were re-sent to the same replica. The planner now sends a review kick (per-perspective, head, combined or decision) only to an agent with none in flight, picks the first free one in name order, and lets work wait for a later cycle when every candidate is busy. Waiting costs no `max_redispatch` or `head_max_retries`.
- Hide the `refs` chip after a red, stale pull request releases its issue back to actionable work.
- A seeded policy that differs from the embedded default with no seed record is now warned about once instead of on every reconcile tick ([#13825](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13825), [#13835](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13835)).
- A self-report "cleared" comment that GitHub refuses with a permanent error (403, 404, 410 or 422) is now recorded once and no longer retried every cycle; transient failures are retried with exponential backoff and given up after a capped number of attempts ([#13827](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13827)).
- Copilot sniff client disconnects before the TLS handshake (EOF, reset, closed connection) are now logged at debug instead of warning, so they no longer raise repeated runtime-error reports (#13828, #13831).
- Review evidence no longer fails with "permission denied" when a PR's evidence directory was created by another user: the bundle is written to a writer-owned `<pr>.uid<N>` sibling directory that the evidence readers (API, dashboard, `hivectl evidence`) also consult. New evidence directories are created group-writable (`0o2775`), and existing ones the writer owns are widened to match ([#13836](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13836)).
- Prevent routine pending-review expiry retries from creating repeated-error fleet self-reports across unrelated PRs; expiry logs and exhausted-review reporting remain available ([#13850](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13850)).
- Close-on-merge logs non-closing PR references as informational diagnostics so repeated sweeps do not file spurious runtime-error self-reports ([#13852](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13852)).
- Missing optional human-decision labels now log an informational notice instead of a warning, preventing false fleet self-reports across held PRs while preserving warnings for API and label-write failures and leaving the review marker intact ([#13857](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13857)).
- The CI-poll stop nudge and its `ci_poll_nudge` self-report no longer fire for reviewer-lane agents, which read check status on the PRs they review as evidence rather than waiting on a PR of their own.
- The CI-poll guard no longer interrupts CI-maintainer lanes or reports their routine cross-repository workflow inspection as polling an owned PR ([#13898](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13898)).
- Agent: 'failed to tighten …' interactive-home WARNs are now classified as agent_dir_setup_failed instead of unclassified (#13910).
- Review findings the backlog linker folded into another issue no longer vanish when that issue closes: every ten minutes, alongside the closed-issue stage sweep, the hive reads the `hive:review-backlog-link` comments on recently closed backlog hosts and re-files each still-unchecked `- [ ]` finding as its own backlog issue ("Split from #N (host closed)"), comments the new link on the host, and moves the finding's ledger and fingerprint records to the new issue. Hosts closed as not planned or duplicate keep the findings that match them and only split out unrelated ones; re-runs are idempotent via the new `split_keys` ledger entry keyed on the link-marker key ([#13914](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13914), part of [#13906](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13906)).
- Fleet report: 'prompt timeout — dumping pane' and 'pane content at timeout' agent-readiness diagnostic WARNs are now classified as agent_pane_timeout (low severity) instead of unclassified_error_repeated (#13920).
- Fleet report: repeated 'failed to ingest bead fact', 'fleet report: cleared comment failed' and 'failed to restore inference home mode' and 'failed to tighten inference home mode' WARNs are now classified instead of filed as unclassified_error_repeated (#13922, #13926, #13930, #13935).
- **Contributor quota guard now scopes to the active model's provider pool** (hivecommons/hive#13946). The contributor relay's quota guard evaluated every agy quota window regardless of which model the contributor actually runs, so an exhausted Claude/GPT (`3p-*`) window paused Gemini contributors that never draw from it. The guard now keeps only the windows of the effective model's pool (Gemini → `gemini-*`, Claude/GPT → `3p-*`); unknown models, non-agy backends and unrecognised window ids are still evaluated conservatively, and the hold message continues to name the triggering window.
- **Review-backlog hosts closed before the split sweep shipped are now split too** (hivecommons/hive#13947). The closed-host split sweep from #13914 only lists issues updated inside its 48h window, so a review-backlog host closed earlier (e.g. #13823, #13629) kept its still-unchecked folded findings closed with it. A one-off `BackfillReviewBacklogSplits` pass now runs after each split sweep: it walks the review-backlog ledger's host index, fetches each host directly and splits every closed one through the same idempotent path (ledger `split_keys`). Once a pass visits every host without hitting the per-pass cap or a transient error, the ledger records `split_backfilled` and later passes are no-ops.
- Policy denials logged by the request watchers (for example a repo not allowlisted for in-place review revision) are no longer self-reported as repeated unclassified runtime errors ([#13955](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13955)).
- Contributor status and authentication hints now use named-instance syntax for Apptainer and Singularity, so the printed tmux attach command works with those runtimes ([#13976](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13976)).
- A delegated decision no longer treats a competing contributor PR whose checks never ran or are still pending as mergeable ([#13986](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13986)).
- Delegated decisions now compare real linked open PRs (including stage-store claim links) and use contributor commits, comments, and reviews within the configured presence window instead of park captions to detect absence; a competitor whose required checks are red is no longer treated as mergeable, and PR decisions fail closed until the dashboard snapshot exists ([#13986](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13986)).
- Agent status snapshots now preserve CI waiting state, CI polling nudge counts, bootstrap overrides, kick refusals, and diagnostic errors.
- Evidence **Issue opens : PR merges** panel: a `?repo=`-filtered view now reads that repo's own governor cadence mode (`State.RepoModes`, under `cadence_scope: per_repo`) instead of always judging it against the fleet-wide mode, so a quiet repo inside a busy fleet is no longer read against the fleet's drain band; falls back to the fleet mode when the governor has no per-repo mode for it (#13992).
- Owner-delegate LLM decider: a model reply must carry its recording action (`comment-decision`, or `close-as-duplicate` for the close verdicts) so it can never lift `stage/085-needs-decision` with a bare `labels-remove`; `close-duplicate` closes only the newer item; verdict and actions are validated together so the job and audit log never record a verdict the executor did not carry out (follow-up to #14000).
- Delegated decisions now check the DCO sign-off and reporter-trust gates before preferring a competing PR, so a PR parked on either gate is no longer approved or superseded just because a duplicate exists (#14001).
- Contributor hubs whose GitHub App has no installation on the org (`installation_id: 0`) now refuse work with `app_not_installed` and a message naming the org and the App install link, instead of `repo_unmintable`; no GitHub request is made and no repository is excluded ([#14002](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14002)).
- Exclude repositories with recorded token mint failures from contributor ready/actionable totals during their cooldown, expose the reason and expiry in opted-in withheld diagnostics, and preserve `repo_unmintable` refusals on subsequent work requests ([#14003](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14003)).
- A hive whose policy directory predates the seed-manifest tracking no longer opens an `unclassified_error_repeated` self-report for the burst of once-per-template `policies: seeded policy differs from the embedded default with no seed record` warnings on its first post-upgrade reconcile; the per-path dedup added for [#13825](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13825) only covered one file repeating over time, not many unrelated files warning once each in the same boot ([#14005](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14005)).
- Review evidence no longer repeats the "could not write bundle" warning for every new head when a PR's evidence directory denies writes; it is logged once per PR directory ([#14008](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14008), [#14009](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14009)).
- Issue comments posted through the hive client no longer stay fenced forever after an ambiguous failure: an `issue_comment` operation journaled Unknown is now reconciled against the issue's existing comments (replayed as success when the comment landed, retried when it did not), and expired after `DefaultUnresolvedTTL` when the comments cannot be read, clearing the `effect_ledger_op_stuck` self-report ([#14011](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14011)).
- A fleet-report cleared comment refused with 403 (a hosted hive's App cannot write to the fleet repo) is now journaled as a definite refusal instead of an uncertain outcome needing reconciliation, so it is given up once rather than re-warned every tick ([#14012](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14012)).
- The fleet-report classifier now recognises the GitHub App "installation does not cover every configured repo" warning (new low-severity `github_app_repo_not_covered` class) and the `copilot sniff: client TLS handshake failed` line (now part of `proxy_tls_handshake_failed`), so they no longer surface as `unclassified_error_repeated` ([#14013](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14013), [#14014](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14014)).
- The CI-poll guard no longer reports a merge sweep or CI-repair pass that reads each of several PRs' checks once as polling an owned PR; only command lines repeated within a kick count toward the nudge threshold and the `ci_poll_nudge` self-report ([#14016](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14016)).
- The auto-merge sweeps (self-authored, trusted-author, queued and contributor-lane) now record a `merge-queue-required` skip when a repository ruleset refuses the direct merge with "Changes must be made through the merge queue", instead of logging a `merge-failed` WARN every pass that surfaced as `unclassified_error_repeated` ([#14018](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14018)).
- A hive whose copilot agents share a model id the Copilot CLI rejects no longer opens an `unclassified_error_repeated` self-report for the burst of `copilot CLI substituted the configured model` warnings; each agent already warns only once per substitution ([#13659](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/13659)), but many agents warning once each in the same boot crossed the repeat threshold. The substitution still shows on each agent's dashboard error and in the container log ([#14020](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14020)).
- ioscan classifier: the "no model endpoint resolved" and "fail-closed blocked kick" warnings are logged once per condition instead of on every call, so a hive without an ioscan model endpoint no longer floods its log and the fleet self-report ([#14025](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14025), [#14027](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14027), [#14028](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14028)).
- Stage-label provisioning stops retrying a repository GitHub reports as archived (403 "Repository was archived so is read-only"); the refusal is logged once with the remedy instead of on every sweep ([#14026](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14026)).
- Fleet report: repeated `proxy: CONNECT dial failed` WARNs are now classified as `proxy_connect_dial_failed` (medium, component `github-proxy`) and `inference upstream failed` / `inference upstream error` ERRORs as `inference_upstream_error` (medium, component `inference-gateway`) instead of `unclassified_error_repeated`; the self-authored automerge sweep now logs `self-authored automerge sweep skipped PR` at WARN once per PR/reason/error and at Debug on later ticks ([#14031](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14031), [#14038](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14038), [#14042](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14042)).
- Hosted hubs no longer repeat HTTP 403 warnings for the channel commit-date, channel-distance and SHA-poll commit-message GitHub fetches on every poll; repeats are logged at debug (#14033, #14034, #14040)
- The tool-less `claude` classifier backend now passes `--settings '{"disableAllHooks":true}'`, so hooks in the host's `~/.claude/settings.json` do not run in the classifier session ([#14062](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14062)).
- CI-poll nudges no longer miss repeated polls of one PR when earlier reads have scrolled out of the 2000-line terminal capture (#14065)
- The self-authored auto-merge sweep now remembers a base branch that only accepts merges through GitHub's merge queue and stops re-issuing the refused direct merge on every pass, logging the `merge-queue-required` skip once per PR head instead of repeatedly ([#14068](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14068)).
- Set NO_PROXY for loopback on every agent backend and stop warning when the proxy fails to forward to loopback (#14076)
- fix(dashboard): settings parity test matches whole paths, not substrings (#14080)
- Plain-forward proxy transport no longer honours HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY on the proxy process, so the guarded destination check always evaluates the agent-named host (#14086)
- fix(close-on-merge): settle a referenced issue that GitHub reports as not found (404) as `issue_not_found` at Info instead of re-reading it every sweep and logging a WARN, which produced repeated `unclassified_error_repeated` self-reports (#14088, #14091)
- The GitLab forge adapter no longer reports a closed (unmerged) merge request as already merged: a closed MR is refused as not mergeable before any write, and a 406 from the accept endpoint is resolved against the re-read MR state. Follow-up to [#14151](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/pull/14151) ([#14113](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14113)).
- GitHub App token minting, installation verification and `InstallationID()` now read the installation ID under the auth lock, so adopting a discovered installation can no longer race a concurrent scoped-token mint or send a request with a torn ID ([#14123](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14123)).
- CI: the sliced `test-hub` / `test-agent` lanes append the `ok <pkg>` / `FAIL <pkg>` summary line the coverage scorer classifies packages by, so a partial selection that includes `pkg/hub` or `crux/agent` no longer fails with "produced no test result" and their floors are scored on full runs again (#14135).
- The `crux-sync` workflow no longer aborts after committing the publish tree: the commit summary was piped through `head`, which under `pipefail` turned into exit 141 on a large first sync (#14138).
- `crux-sync` no longer commits when the only difference is the `.hive-sync` timestamp, so tag-only runs and re-dispatches do not add empty syncs (#14138).
- `crux-sync` tag runs (`crux/vX.Y.Z`) no longer commit to `hivecommons/crux` `main`; they tag the already-synced commit whose tree matches the tagged hive commit, fail clearly when none does, and refuse to overwrite an existing tag (#14138).
- `crux/hivecap`'s direct-vs-socket parity test used a fixed token expiry of 2026-10-25T14:00Z and began failing once that moment passed; it now uses a relative expiry (#14138).
- The Crux module's tests now pass when it is built standalone (the published `hivecommons/crux` copy): `crux/logscrub`'s relay secret-pattern parity test and `crux/agent`'s `deploy/entrypoint.sh` and `src/Dockerfile` checks skip when those hive-root files are absent instead of failing on a missing file; inside hive, `HIVE_TEST_REQUIRE_BEHAVIOURAL=1` still turns a missing file into a failure (#14138).
- SHA poller now backs off and logs once when a commit message can't be fetched (e.g. GitHub 403), and the fleet report classifies it (#14146)
- The automerge sweeps (queued, self-authored, trusted-author, contributor lane) and the close-on-merge ledger and backfill sweeps now skip repos whose `project.forge` / `project.repo_policies[].forge` resolves to GitLab or Gitea. Before, they looked those repos up on GitHub under the same slug ([#14150](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14150), part of [#14096](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14096)). Merging and closing on those forges is still to come.
- The supersession sweep's `needs-human` now clears with its cause: a contributor PR that only references the closed issue (`Refs #N`, `Part of #N`) is noted, not parked, and a park from an earlier pass is released when the supersession no longer holds (issue reopened, claim rewritten, reference-only link); a person's `needs-human` is left alone. The `stage/085-needs-decision` note names `needs-human` as the condition instead of "the lane condition named above" (#14155).
- A contributor websocket that ends without a close frame (code 1006 — relay killed, laptop slept, NAT timeout) is now logged at INFO as a dropped connection instead of a WARN `[contribute-ws] read error`, so routine contributor network drops no longer surface as `unclassified_error_repeated` fleet self-reports; close codes that name a protocol or policy problem still log at WARN ([#14163](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14163)).
- Retiring the old `needs-decision` / `needs-direction` label definitions no longer logs a warning when its context deadline runs out: a timeout now defers quietly to the next cycle, and a pass whose caller's deadline is already spent makes no request (#14171).
- Unpark sweep and stage-label PR-link comments now skip repositories GitHub has archived (403 "Repository was archived so is read-only") instead of retrying and warning on every sweep tick (#14177, #14213).
- The fleet self-report feed no longer reports the contribute-ws "refusing task: contributor failure streak" warning as a repeated runtime error: the claim pause is a policy outcome re-logged on every poll from the paused agent, not a defect ([#14178](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14178)).
- The CI-poll guard now exempts the quality lane's mandatory shared-CI baseline triage, alongside reviewer and CI-maintainer lanes, so cross-PR check reads do not trigger a stop-polling nudge or `ci_poll_nudge` self-report (#14188).
- **Blocked-on relations: state check before write, supersede re-targeting, and periodic sweep.** Posting a `hive:blocked-on` comment checks the target PR's state first and refuses to park on an already merged or closed PR (posting a verification note instead); closing a blocker as superseded re-targets relations to the replacement PR (or unblocks when the replacement is already merged); a periodic reconciliation sweep unblocks issues whose blocker merged or closed across cycles (#14194).
- fix(claims): a claim's GitHub side effects and the release of that same claim ran in independent goroutines, so a release that followed a slow claim re-read the issue before the claim's `hive/claimed-by-human` label had landed, skipped it, and the label was then applied onto an already-released issue — orphaned until a person noticed (hivecommons/hive#14065, 2026-10-25). The claim hooks now run one issue's transitions in ledger order; a release only reads the issue after its claim has finished writing. (#14216, fixes #14201)
- Agent claims clear a stale `hive/claimed-by-human` label when the latest human claim has a matching release marker, recovering from missed release label writes (#14239).
- Issue stage-label sweeps stop cleanly when their best-effort budget expires or the request pacer fails fast before the deadline instead of reporting a write failure for every unattempted issue; live-context request failures still warn once and unfinished work retries next cycle. PR sweeps also skip comments and adoption side effects for the unattempted batch tail.
- Fixed GitLab proxy repo scoping so nested group project paths (`group/sub/repo`) are no longer truncated to `group/sub`, both on `/api/v4/projects/...` and on git smart-HTTP pushes (`/group/sub/repo.git/git-receive-pack`, which previously extracted no repo and skipped the per-repo gates). The per-repo write gates (pause, agent scope, auto-merge, per-repo ACMM mode, repo filter) and the refusal audit entry now read a canonicalized form of the client's escaped path — every segment percent-decoded, with only `%2F` kept as the GitLab project separator — so `%2F`-encoded projects resolve exactly and neither escaped slug letters (`o%72g/repo`) nor escaped structural segments (`/r%65pos/`, `repo%2Egit`, `pro%6Aects`, `merg%65`) can slip past a pause, scope, allowlist or auto-merge entry. Git smart-HTTP slug extraction is also anchored to `info/refs`, `git-upload-pack` and `git-receive-pack`, so a `.git/` elsewhere in an API path no longer yields a bogus slug (#14250)
- `hive-open-pr` no longer folds a new PR into an open bot PR that is held, stalled, needs a rebase or has merge conflicts, since the hive cannot push to it; only the overlapping-files check skips such PRs, and a PR closing the same issue still counts as a duplicate (#14296).
- Dashboard feedback issue refresh: non-JSON (HTML) responses are reported with their HTTP status instead of a bare json decode error, and repeated failures back off instead of warning on every request (#14300).
- `claude` agents no longer stop on Claude Code's "WARNING: Claude Code running in Bypass Permissions mode" screen with "No, exit" selected. Hive seeds `skipDangerousModePermissionPrompt` into the shared Claude settings that `claude` agents read, so the screen does not appear. If it appears anyway, a kick selects "Yes, I accept" instead of restarting the CLI into the same screen, and the watcher's consent-stuck dismissal now covers `claude` agents as well as inference backends ([#14307](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14307)).
- A wedged agent kick can no longer hold a hub-instructed self-upgrade for the full drain window. A kick whose turn-end signal never arrived stayed "in flight" forever, so the drain could never finish and every upgrade waited `hub.upgrade_drain_timeout_s` before it went ahead. Now a kick left unsettled for longer than the agent's `continuous_turn_ceiling` (45m by default, and also when the ceiling is unset or disabled) no longer counts toward the drain. Hive logs one warning per drain pass listing the wedged agents and kick ages, and the drain's deferred, timed-out and complete log lines list the ignored agents as `ignored_wedged` ([#14323](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14323)).
- GitLab project paths with a subgroup or project named like a resource word (for example `group/packages/repo`) are documented as ambiguous in the unencoded spelling, with a test pinning the behaviour; nested-group git smart-HTTP pushes are covered by the repo filter tests (#14324, #14321).
- The dashboard's `jsonResponse`/`jsonError` no longer log a WARN when the client went away mid-response (broken pipe, connection reset, cancelled request, handler timeout); those are logged at DEBUG, and WARN is kept for genuine encode failures ([#14325](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14325)).
- fix(agent): only selfreport ci_poll_nudge at 3+ CI polls so the kick's two-status-check allowance is not reported fleet-wide (#14327)
- The knowledge primer's "dropped facts over the byte cap" notice is now logged at INFO once per agent and cap (again only when the omitted fact count changes) and at DEBUG otherwise, instead of at WARN on every kick; the fleet self-report classifier already treats it as benign ([#14328](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14328)).
- fix(ci-runners): bump pinned GitHub CLI to 2.103.2 (apt dropped 2.102.0) (#14341)
- An older, retracted `/hive decision` is no longer replayed after an issue is parked again; once a newer decision has been answered, earlier commands are treated as superseded (#14344).
- Expected per-agent GitHub hourly cap and soft-budget warnings no longer open repeated-error fleet self-reports; quota enforcement and diagnostic logs remain unchanged (#14346).
- Stale automerge `required_checks` configuration warnings remain visible in logs without generating repeated runtime-error self-reports; repository protection checks continue to govern merges.
- Issue-request consolidation no longer folds a finding into an open issue parked on a maintainer decision or owned by another `agent/<lane>`, and a consolidated result now reports `consolidated_reason` (`subject`, `file_set` or `component:<path>`) (#14360).
- The review swarm no longer deadlocks on verdicts whose `body_digest` or `head_sha` the reviewer miscopied, or when a PR's review runs out of redispatches ([#14361](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14361)). The relay now stores every dispatched verdict under the head SHA and body digest its dispatch recorded, ignoring the reviewer's copy. Models had returned a prose summary, a `sha256:`-prefixed hash or a hash of something else. Each such verdict was filed apart from the PR's review, so its perspective never counted as delivered and its pending entry never cleared. Separately, under one review kick in flight per agent (#13794), every pending entry made its agent busy. That included entries an exhausted head deliberately keeps (so it is never re-kicked) and entries already past `pending_ttl` on a PR not yet reached this cycle. Three such PRs pinned every review head and the decision agent, and the swarm dispatched nothing for about 36 hours while every reviewer sat idle. Now only live entries (inside `pending_ttl`, on a head that is not exhausted) count as load. Pending entries naming agents the hive no longer runs (a replica or head removed by lowering `replicas`) are pruned so their perspective is asked again. An exhausted head is labelled with the `requires_human` verdict label instead of staying on `reviewing` indefinitely. Review prompts now tell reviewers to copy `head_sha` and `body_digest` verbatim or leave them out. `review.verdict_labels` fixes: a PR moving to a new state now loses its previous verdict label, even one the hive had already removed once. Before, the second removal was deduplicated as already done, so `hive-review/in-progress` and `hive-review/approved` could both show. A PR that merges or closes while carrying a verdict label now has it removed (at most 25 removals every 10 minutes).
- Repeated merge-request CI gate refusals remain visible in operator logs without generating spurious fleet runtime-defect reports (#14364).
- Pull request creation no longer refuses retries forever after an ambiguous GitHub failure; the unresolved op is reconciled against the open PR for the head branch (#14366)
- An agent the ACMM pack paused as "not in pack level N" is no longer resumed by the startup pack apply at that same level when an upgrade ships a pack that now lists it (e.g. `reviewer` joining the L2–L4 packs); it stays paused until the operator resumes it or explicitly re-applies the pack ([#14368](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14368)).
- Classify timed-out Codex headroom probes as timeouts instead of unclassified closed-pipe or missing-response failures.
- Stop repeatedly retrying optional legacy decision label definition cleanup when GitHub denies the integration permission; retry after the client restarts.
- A burst of shadow-mode "shadow fence would have denied external mutation" warnings no longer files repeated runtime-error self-reports; the warning stays in logs and enforce-mode denials remain reportable.
- CI-poll self-reports now describe observed repeated CI-status commands and distinguish repeated reads from total reads, rather than claiming the agent was polling its own PR when PR ownership is unknown (#14384).
- Transient GitHub failures fetching PR review decisions no longer trigger repeated unclassified fleet defect reports; review decisions remain unknown until a successful poll.
- Spoke self-upgrades now raise stale startup probe thresholds to the hosted 10-minute budget in the same rollout, preventing older deployments from retaining the 160-second limit after upgrades (#14389).
- fix(entrypoint): keep the .codex/.gemini re-own off PID 1's startup path (#14390)
- hive-open-pr.sh stub-PATH test now provides dirname, which the script's SCRIPT_DIR line requires, so it passes on runner images that do not resolve it implicitly ([#14406](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14406)).
- Hive Chat now answers agent questions instead of dumping the roster (#14409). `/agents stuck`, `/agents scanner status` and "Which agent completed last?" all used to return the identical 16-line agent list with a bare `BLOCKED` label and no reason. `/agents stuck|blocked|paused|running|idle|failed` now filter the roster, blocked agents carry the hive's recorded WHY (rate-limit cap, inference auth, policy stand-down, crash loop, failed starts) and since-when, `/agents <name> [status|why|last|history]` / `/agents status <name>` / "scanner status" return only that agent's card (state, block reason, current task, last completed turn and outcome, last kick, last PR/issue, restarts; unknown names list the valid agents), and natural-language questions — "which agent completed last", "what is scanner doing", "why is reviewer-2 blocked", "when did scanner last run", "which agents are idle" — go through a table-driven intent matcher. Unmatched agent questions reach the configured chat responder with the agent state attached rather than the roster. Bare `/agents` keeps the roster but appends the block reason inline. The reason and timestamp are exposed on `/api/status` `agents[]` as `blockedReason` / `blockedSince` (plus `kickOutcomeAt`) so chat and the Agents page agree.
- Spoke image self-upgrades reuse a single Deployment read for container images and startup probe backfill, avoiding a redundant Kubernetes API GET ([#14418](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14418)).
- Backfill stale spoke startup probes when the Deployment already matches the requested image, without repeatedly restarting an in-flight rollout.
- Immediately remove PRs merged or closed by the hive from the stage tracker and governor snapshot, without waiting for a webhook or sweep ([#14420](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14420)).
- Retry the pinned Pi coding-agent npm install in `Dockerfile.contributor` up to three times with a 30s delay, so a registry tarball that briefly 404s while a release propagates no longer fails the contributor image build.
- Stop reporting the expected post-restart kick hold (`failed to send kick` with `kick held after restart`, #7363) as an `unclassified_error_repeated` self-report; other kick send failures still report (#14422).
- Self-managed Kubernetes deployments and the manual provisioning template now allow the same ten-minute startup budget as hosted spokes, avoiding premature restarts during slow first boots.
- Hive Chat `/prs waiting on review` no longer lists pull requests whose review decision is changes requested; those wait on their author, not on a reviewer ([#14437](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14437)).
- cmd/hive: the sidecar supervision boot test no longer hangs the test shard; waits are bounded.
- The adopted-PR stall escalation to `stage/085-needs-decision` ("adopted PR sits with nothing the hive can push") is now logged at INFO instead of WARN. It is designed behaviour (one stall note per PR), and the WARN made the `unclassified_error_repeated` classifier file fleet self-reports when several contributor PRs stalled together ([#14466](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14466)).
- crux: the Makefile test note no longer points at a non-existent AGENTS.md; the tmux rule is stated inline with a link to hive's AGENTS.md ([#14468](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14468)).
- Review backlog findings in files untouched by the reviewed PR are actionable immediately instead of waiting for that PR to close or merge.
- A relay resuming a task the hub holds no lease for (e.g. after a hub restart or lease expiry) is still told to re-ready, but the rejection is no longer logged as a repeated warning ([#14478](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14478)).
- Adopted contributor PRs that were red only because of a shared-CI or base-branch flake fixed on the base since — their heads 15–22 commits behind `v5` with CI never re-run (hivecommons/hive#14430, #14440, #14456 after #14406 was fixed by #14415) — were escalated to `stage/085-needs-decision` as "nothing the hive can push". The 074 escape now tries one recovery first when the head's failing check is green on the base tip: it merges the base into the head (GitHub update-branch, also on a maintainer-editable fork) when the head is behind, or re-runs the failed workflow jobs when it is current, at most once per (head, base tip) and three times per adoption, recorded on the stage record; an escalation already in place for that head is released, and 085 waits until the attempt was made and the head is still red. One `adopted PR recovery` log line names the outcome (`update-branch`, `rerun-failed-jobs`, `skipped:<why>`) (hivecommons/hive#14500).
- Report runtime semantic classifier failures that withhold kicks in the dashboard ([#14509](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14509)).
- fix(agent): document pacing-seam override rule (#14515)
- Fleet report: the pr-request watcher's repeated `head branch is not on the remote` ERROR is now classified as `pr_request_head_unpushed` (medium, component `github-relay`) instead of `unclassified_error_repeated` ([#14526](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14526)).
- The hold guard's merge-from-base sync for held PRs is now pinned to the head it enumerated (`expected_head_sha`), so a contributor push landing mid-tick makes GitHub refuse the update instead of stacking the hive's base merge on unreviewed commits. A stale-head refusal is logged and skipped without a conflict notice, leaving the guard's baseline in place for the next drift check ([#14537](https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/14537)).
